source.text: Ἔπειτα διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν πάλιν ἀνέβην εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα μετὰ Βαρναβᾶ συμπαραλαβὼν καὶ Τίτον·

records.literal_gloss: Then after fourteen years again I went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, having taken along also Titus;

en.L: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also.
en.B: Then, fourteen years later, I went up to Jerusalem again, this time with Barnabas, and I took Titus along as well.
en.R: Fourteen years later I went back to Jerusalem. Barnabas went with me, and I also took Titus.

es.L: Luego, después de catorce años, subí de nuevo a Jerusalén con Bernabé, llevando también [conmigo] a Tito.
es.B: Luego, catorce años más tarde, volví a subir a Jerusalén, esta vez con Bernabé, y llevé también a Tito.
es.R: Catorce años después regresé a Jerusalén. Bernabé fue conmigo, y también llevé a Tito.

sw.L: Kisha baada ya miaka kumi na minne nilipanda tena kwenda Yerusalemu pamoja na Barnaba, nikamchukua Tito pia.
sw.B: Kisha, miaka kumi na minne baadaye, nilipanda tena Yerusalemu, safari hii pamoja na Barnaba, nikamchukua na Tito pia.
sw.R: Miaka kumi na minne baadaye nilirudi Yerusalemu. Barnaba alikwenda pamoja nami, na nilimchukua Tito pia.

fr.L: Ensuite, au bout de quatorze ans, je suis monté de nouveau à Jérusalem avec Barnabas, en emmenant aussi Tite.
fr.B: Puis, quatorze ans plus tard, je suis remonté à Jérusalem, cette fois avec Barnabas, et j’ai aussi emmené Tite.
fr.R: Quatorze ans plus tard, je suis retourné à Jérusalem. Barnabas est venu avec moi, et j’ai aussi emmené Tite.

ko.L: 그 후 십사 년 뒤에 나는 바나바와 함께 다시 예루살렘으로 올라갔고, 디도도 데리고 갔습니다.
ko.B: 그 뒤 십사 년이 지나서 나는 다시 예루살렘으로 올라갔습니다. 이번에는 바나바와 함께 갔고, 디도도 데리고 갔습니다.
ko.R: 십사 년이 지난 뒤에 나는 다시 예루살렘으로 갔습니다. 바나바가 나와 함께 갔고, 디도도 데리고 갔습니다.

vi.L: Rồi sau mười bốn năm, tôi lại lên Giê-ru-sa-lem với Ba-na-ba, cũng đem theo Tít.
vi.B: Rồi mười bốn năm sau, tôi lại lên Giê-ru-sa-lem, lần này cùng với Ba-na-ba, và tôi cũng đem Tít theo.
vi.R: Mười bốn năm sau, tôi trở lại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ba-na-ba đi với tôi, và tôi cũng đem Tít theo.

pt.L: Depois, passados catorze anos, subi outra vez a Jerusalém com Barnabé, levando também Tito.
pt.B: Depois, catorze anos mais tarde, subi de novo a Jerusalém, desta vez com Barnabé, e levei Tito também.
pt.R: Catorze anos depois, voltei a Jerusalém. Barnabé foi comigo, e também levei Tito.

am.L: ከዚያም ከዐሥራ አራት ዓመት በኋላ ቲቶን ደግሞ ይዤ ከበርናባስ ጋር እንደ ገና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣሁ።
am.B: ከዚያም ከዐሥራ አራት ዓመት በኋላ እንደ ገና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣሁ፤ በዚህ ጊዜ ከበርናባስ ጋር ነበርኩ፤ ቲቶንም ደግሞ ይዤ ሄድኩ።
am.R: ከዐሥራ አራት ዓመት በኋላ እንደ ገና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለስኩ። በርናባስ ከእኔ ጋር ሄደ፤ ቲቶንም ደግሞ ይዤ ሄድኩ።

hi.L: फिर चौदह वर्ष के बाद मैं बरनबास के साथ फिर यरूशलेम को गया, और तीतुस को भी साथ ले गया।
hi.B: फिर चौदह वर्ष बाद मैं फिर से यरूशलेम गया, इस बार बरनबास के साथ, और तीतुस को भी अपने साथ ले गया।
hi.R: चौदह साल बाद मैं फिर यरूशलेम गया। बरनबास मेरे साथ था, और मैं तीतुस को भी साथ ले गया।

ru.L: Затем через четырнадцать лет я снова поднялся в Иерусалим с Варнавой, взяв с собой и Тита.
ru.B: Потом, четырнадцать лет спустя, я снова поднялся в Иерусалим, на этот раз с Варнавой, и взял с собой также Тита.
ru.R: Через четырнадцать лет я снова пошёл в Иерусалим. Со мной пошёл Варнава, и я взял с собой ещё Тита.

ja.L: それから十四年を経て、わたしはテトスも連れて、バルナバと共に再びエルサレムに上りました。
ja.B: それから十四年後、わたしは再びエルサレムに上りました。今度はバルナバと一緒で、テトスも連れて行きました。
ja.R: 十四年後、わたしはまたエルサレムへ行きました。バルナバがいっしょに行き、わたしはテトスも連れて行きました。

uk.L: Потім, через чотирнадцять років, я знову пішов до Єрусалима з Варнавою, взявши з собою й Тита.
uk.B: Потім, через чотирнадцять років, я знову пішов до Єрусалима, цього разу з Варнавою, і взяв із собою також Тита.
uk.R: Через чотирнадцять років я знову пішов до Єрусалима. Зі мною пішов Варнава, і я також узяв Тита.

decisions.choice: fourteen years counted either from Paul's call or from his first visit; the text does not say which
alternatives: fourteen years after his first visit to Jerusalem (1:18)
decisions.reason: Ἔπειτα ("then") is the word that marked each step of the story in 1:18 and 1:21, and "again" points back to the visit of 1:18. The fourteen years may be counted from that visit or from God's call in 1:15-16. Paul's point is the same either way: for years he had little contact with the Jerusalem leaders, so his gospel did not come from them.

decisions.choice: went up: the usual way of speaking of travel to Jerusalem
alternatives: a reference to rank or importance
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stands high in the hill country, and Jews spoke of going "up" to it from anywhere (1:17-18; Psalm 122:4). The word says nothing about Paul submitting to the city's leaders.

decisions.choice: Barnabas, a Jewish believer, and Titus, a Gentile believer, both Paul's fellow workers
decisions.reason: Barnabas was a Jew from Cyprus who brought Paul to the apostles and worked beside him in Antioch and on his first journey (Acts 4:36; 9:27; 11:25-26; 13:2). Titus was a Greek (verse 3) and later one of Paul's trusted helpers (2 Corinthians 8:23). Taking an uncircumcised Gentile believer to Jerusalem made him a test case, as verse 3 shows.

decisions.choice: this visit is either the famine-relief visit of Acts 11:29-30 or the meeting of Acts 15
alternatives: a visit not recorded in Acts
decisions.reason: Acts tells of Paul going to Jerusalem with Barnabas to bring help in a famine (Acts 11:29-30) and again for the meeting about circumcising Gentiles (Acts 15:1-29). Galatians 2:1-10 fits parts of both accounts. The text of Galatians does not settle which one Paul means.

decisions.choice: fourteen years later (B, R); this time with Barnabas (B); went back (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the ordinary way of saying "after fourteen years". Readable says "went back" for "went up again", since the idea of going up to Jerusalem (m2) needs no explaining at that level.

decisions.choice: passé composé for Paul's account at every level, as set out in 1:13
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Chapter 2 continues the first-person story Paul tells his readers, so it keeps the tense chosen in 1:13 ("je suis monté", "je lui ai résisté"), with the imparfait for habits and gradual change (2:12).

decisions.choice: "Ba-na-ba", "Tít"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliterations, as the Vietnamese Colossians has "Ba-na-ba" (4:10); "Ti-tô" is the Catholic form.

source.text: ἀνέβην δὲ κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν· καὶ ἀνεθέμην αὐτοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ κηρύσσω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, κατ’ ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς δοκοῦσιν, μή πως εἰς κενὸν τρέχω ἢ ἔδραμον.

records.literal_gloss: I went up and according to a revelation; and I set before them the gospel which I proclaim among the Gentiles, privately but to those seeming, lest somehow in vain I run or ran.

en.L: And I went up because of a revelation, and I laid before them the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles, but privately, before those who seemed [to be leaders], lest somehow I might be running or had run in vain.
en.B: I went up because God had shown me that I should. I set out before them the gospel I proclaim among the Gentiles, though I did this privately, with those who were regarded as leaders. I did not want to find that I was running, or had run, for nothing.
en.R: God had shown me that I should go. I explained to them the good news I tell the Gentiles. I did it in private, with the people who were seen as leaders. I did not want all my work, past and present, to be wasted.

es.L: Y subí conforme a una revelación, y les expuse el evangelio que proclamo entre los gentiles, pero en privado, a los que parecían [ser dirigentes], no fuera que de algún modo estuviera corriendo o hubiera corrido en vano.
es.B: Subí porque Dios me había mostrado que debía hacerlo. Les presenté el evangelio que proclamo entre los gentiles, aunque lo hice en privado, ante los que eran tenidos por dirigentes. No quería descubrir que estaba corriendo, o que había corrido, en vano.
es.R: Dios me había mostrado que debía ir. Les expliqué la buena noticia que anuncio a los gentiles. Lo hice en privado, con los que eran considerados líderes. No quería que todo mi trabajo, el de antes y el de ahora, se perdiera.

sw.L: Nami nilipanda kwa sababu ya ufunuo, nikawaeleza Injili ninayoihubiri kati ya watu wa mataifa, lakini faraghani, mbele ya wale walioonekana [kuwa viongozi], nisije kwa namna fulani nikawa ninakimbia au nimekimbia bure.
sw.B: Nilipanda kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amenionyesha kwamba nipande. Niliwaeleza Injili ninayoihubiri kati ya watu wa mataifa, ingawa nilifanya hivyo faraghani, pamoja na wale waliotambulika kuwa viongozi. Sikutaka kugundua kwamba nilikuwa ninakimbia, au nilikuwa nimekimbia, bure.
sw.R: Mungu alikuwa amenionyesha kwamba niende. Niliwaeleza Habari Njema ninayowaambia watu wa mataifa. Nilifanya hivyo faraghani, pamoja na watu waliotambulika kuwa viongozi. Sikutaka kazi yangu yote, ya zamani na ya sasa, ipotee bure.

fr.L: Et j’y suis monté à la suite d’une révélation, et je leur ai exposé l’Évangile que je proclame parmi les nations, mais en privé, à ceux qui étaient considérés [comme importants], de peur de courir, ou d’avoir couru, pour rien.
fr.B: J’y suis monté parce que Dieu m’avait montré que je devais le faire. Je leur ai exposé l’Évangile que je proclame parmi les nations, mais je l’ai fait en privé, avec ceux qu’on considérait comme les responsables. Je ne voulais pas découvrir que je courais, ou que j’avais couru, pour rien.
fr.R: Dieu m’avait montré que je devais y aller. Je leur ai expliqué la bonne nouvelle que j’annonce aux non-Juifs. Je l’ai fait en privé, avec les gens qu’on voyait comme les chefs. Je ne voulais pas que tout mon travail, passé et présent, soit perdu.

ko.L: 나는 계시를 따라 올라갔고, 내가 이방 사람들 가운데서 전하는 복음을 그들에게 내놓았습니다. 그러나 유력해 보이는 사람들에게는 따로 [내놓았으니], 내가 달리고 있는 것이나 달린 것이 혹시라도 헛되지 않게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 내가 올라간 것은 하나님께서 그렇게 하라고 보여 주셨기 때문입니다. 나는 이방 사람들 가운데서 전하는 복음을 그들 앞에 설명했습니다. 다만 지도자로 인정받는 사람들과는 따로 만나서 그렇게 했습니다. 내가 지금 달리고 있는 것이나 이미 달린 것이 헛수고가 되지 않게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 나에게 가야 한다고 보여 주셨기 때문에 나는 그곳에 갔습니다. 나는 유대인이 아닌 사람들에게 전하는 기쁜 소식을 그들에게 설명했습니다. 지도자로 여겨지는 사람들과 따로 만나서 그렇게 했습니다. 내가 지금까지 해 온 일과 지금 하고 있는 일이 모두 헛되게 되기를 원하지 않았기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Tôi đã lên theo sự mặc khải, và trình bày với họ Tin Lành mà tôi rao giảng giữa các dân ngoại, nhưng riêng với những người có vẻ [là lãnh đạo], kẻo tôi đang chạy hoặc đã chạy cách luống công.
vi.B: Tôi lên đó vì Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ cho tôi phải đi. Tôi trình bày với họ Tin Lành mà tôi rao giảng giữa các dân ngoại, nhưng tôi làm điều ấy cách riêng tư, với những người được xem là lãnh đạo. Tôi không muốn thấy rằng mình đang chạy, hoặc đã chạy, cách vô ích.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã cho tôi biết là tôi nên đi. Tôi giải thích cho họ Tin Lành mà tôi nói cho các dân ngoại. Tôi làm điều đó cách riêng tư, với những người được xem là lãnh đạo. Tôi không muốn mọi công khó của tôi, trước đây cũng như bây giờ, trở nên uổng phí.

pt.L: E subi por causa de uma revelação, e expus a eles o evangelho que proclamo entre as nações, mas em particular, aos que pareciam [ser líderes], para que de algum modo eu não estivesse correndo ou não tivesse corrido em vão.
pt.B: Subi porque Deus tinha me mostrado que eu devia ir. Expus a eles o evangelho que proclamo entre os não judeus, mas fiz isso em particular, com os que eram considerados líderes. Eu não queria descobrir que estava correndo, ou que tinha corrido, em vão.
pt.R: Deus tinha me mostrado que eu devia ir. Expliquei a eles as boas-novas que anuncio aos não judeus. Fiz isso em particular, com as pessoas que eram vistas como líderes. Eu não queria que todo o meu trabalho, o de antes e o de agora, fosse desperdiçado.

am.L: የወጣሁትም በመገለጥ ምክንያት ነበር፤ በአሕዛብ መካከል የምሰብከውንም ወንጌል በፊታቸው አቀረብኩ፤ ይህንም [መሪዎች] መስለው ለሚታዩት ለብቻ [አደረግኩ]፤ ምናልባት በከንቱ የምሮጥ ወይም የሮጥኩ እንዳልሆን [ብዬ ነው]።
am.B: የወጣሁት እግዚአብሔር እንድወጣ ስላሳየኝ ነው። በአሕዛብ መካከል የምሰብከውን ወንጌል በፊታቸው አቀረብኩ፤ ይህን ያደረግኩት ግን መሪዎች ተብለው ከሚታወቁት ጋር ለብቻ ነው። የአሁኑም ሆነ ያለፈው ሩጫዬ ከንቱ ሆኖ እንዳላገኘው ፈለግኩ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር እንድሄድ አሳየኝ። አይሁድ ላልሆኑ ሕዝቦች የምነግረውን የምሥራች አስረዳኋቸው። ይህንም ያደረግኩት መሪዎች ተብለው ከሚታዩት ሰዎች ጋር ለብቻ ነው። ያለፈውም ሆነ የአሁኑ ሥራዬ ሁሉ ከንቱ እንዲሆን አልፈለግኩም።

hi.L: और मैं प्रकाशन के अनुसार गया, और जो सुसमाचार मैं अन्यजातियों में प्रचार करता हूँ, वह मैंने उनके सामने रखा, पर अकेले में उनके सामने जो [अगुवे] समझे जाते थे, कहीं ऐसा न हो कि मैं व्यर्थ दौड़ रहा हूँ या दौड़ा हूँ।
hi.B: मैं इसलिए गया क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने मुझ पर प्रकट किया था कि मुझे जाना चाहिए। जो सुसमाचार मैं अन्यजातियों में प्रचार करता हूँ, वह मैंने उनके सामने रखा, पर यह मैंने अकेले में उन लोगों के साथ किया जो अगुवे माने जाते थे। मैं नहीं चाहता था कि अंत में पता चले कि मैं व्यर्थ दौड़ रहा हूँ या व्यर्थ दौड़ चुका हूँ।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने मुझे दिखाया था कि मुझे जाना चाहिए। जो सुसमाचार मैं ग़ैर-यहूदी लोगों को सुनाता हूँ, वह मैंने उन्हें समझाया। यह मैंने अकेले में उन लोगों के साथ किया जो अगुवे माने जाते थे। मैं नहीं चाहता था कि मेरा सारा काम, जो मैंने किया है और जो कर रहा हूँ, बेकार हो जाए।

ru.L: Поднялся же я по откровению и изложил им Евангелие, которое проповедую среди язычников, но наедине — тем, кто считался [руководителями], — чтобы как-нибудь не оказалось, что я бегу или бежал напрасно.
ru.B: Я пошёл туда, потому что Бог открыл мне, что я должен идти. Я изложил им Евангелие, которое проповедую среди язычников, но сделал это наедине, с теми, кого считали руководителями. Я не хотел, чтобы оказалось, что я бегу или бежал напрасно.
ru.R: Бог показал мне, что я должен пойти. Я объяснил им Радостную весть, которую рассказываю людям других народов. Я сделал это наедине с теми, кого считали руководителями. Я не хотел, чтобы вся моя работа, прошлая и нынешняя, пропала даром.

ja.L: わたしが上ったのは、啓示によるものでした。そしてわたしは、異邦人の間で宣べ伝えている福音を彼らに示しました。ただし、おもだった者と見られている人々には、個人的に[示しました]。わたしが無駄に走っている、あるいは走ったのではないかと[恐れた]からです。
ja.B: わたしが上ったのは、神がそうするように示してくださったからです。わたしは、異邦人の間で宣べ伝えている福音を彼らに説明しました。ただし、それは指導者と見なされている人たちとだけ、内々に行いました。自分が走っていること、また走ってきたことが、無駄になってはいけないと思ったからです。
ja.R: わたしがエルサレムへ行ったのは、神がそうするように示してくださったからです。わたしは、ユダヤ人でない人々に伝えている良い知らせのことを、そこの人たちに説明しました。指導者と見られていた人たちとは、ほかの人のいない所で話し合いました。それまでの働きも今の働きも、むだになってほしくなかったのです。

uk.L: А пішов я за одкровенням і виклав їм Євангеліє, яке проповідую серед язичників, але окремо, перед тими, що вважалися [провідниками], щоб якось не бігти або не бігти марно.
uk.B: Я пішов, бо Бог показав мені, що маю піти. Я виклав їм Євангеліє, яке проповідую серед язичників, але зробив це наодинці з тими, кого вважали провідниками. Я не хотів виявити, що біжу чи біг даремно.
uk.R: Бог показав мені, що я маю піти. Я пояснив їм Добру звістку, яку розповідаю неюдеям. Я зробив це наодинці з людьми, яких уважали провідниками. Я не хотів, щоб уся моя праця, і минула, і теперішня, пропала даремно.

decisions.choice: Paul went because God revealed that he should, not because the Jerusalem leaders summoned him
alternatives: he went to explain a revelation he had received
decisions.reason: ἀποκάλυψιν is the word Paul used in 1:12 for the way the gospel came to him from Jesus Christ. Here it tells why he made the journey: God directed it. The point fits his claim in chapter 1 that his gospel and his work were not handed to him by other people. The revelation may have come through a prophet, as in Acts 11:27-30, but Paul does not say.

decisions.choice: two settings: the believers in Jerusalem, and in private those regarded as leaders
alternatives: one private meeting, with the second phrase saying who "them" were
decisions.reason: αὐτοῖς ("to them") most naturally means the believers in Jerusalem, and the next phrase adds a private meeting with the leaders. It could also be one meeting, with the second phrase narrowing "them" to the leaders. Either way, Paul laid his gospel before those whose recognition mattered.

decisions.choice: those regarded as important: the recognized leaders of the Jerusalem church
alternatives: those who only seemed important but were not
decisions.reason: δοκέω means "to seem" or "to be thought", and here it names people held in high regard. Paul uses it four times in this passage (verses 2, 6 and 9), and in verse 9 he names them: James, Cephas and John. He is not mocking them; he keeps a certain distance, because their standing is not what makes the gospel true (verse 6).

decisions.choice: Paul feared his work would be undone, not that his gospel might be wrong
alternatives: Paul was unsure of his gospel and needed the leaders to confirm it
decisions.reason: Running is Paul's picture for his work, as in a race (5:7; Philippians 2:16). If the Jerusalem leaders had refused to recognize Gentile believers without circumcision, the churches he had founded would have been cut off from the believers in Judea and his work damaged. Chapter 1 rules out the thought that he doubted his gospel: he says it came by revelation (1:11-12) and curses anyone who changes it (1:8-9).

decisions.choice: because God had shown me that I should (B); God had shown me that I should go (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose revelation it was and what it was about (m1). "Revelation" alone would sound like a vision of something else.

decisions.choice: I did not want to find that I was running, or had run, for nothing (B); I did not want all my work, past and present, to be wasted (R)
alternatives: lest somehow I should be running or had run in vain
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the running picture in a separate sentence. Readable says plainly what the picture means (m4): his work now and in the past.

decisions.choice: waliotambulika kuwa viongozi
decisions.reason: "Waliohesabiwa" (those counted as) would be the obvious way to say "those who were regarded", but "kuhesabiwa" is kept for "kuhesabiwa haki" (to be justified) from verse 16 on, so "waliotambulika" (those recognized) is used for Paul's word for the leaders here and in verses 6 and 9.

decisions.choice: ceux qui étaient considérés [comme importants] (L); ceux qu'on considérait comme les responsables (B); les gens qu'on voyait comme les chefs (R); the same verb in 2:6 and 2:9
decisions.reason: Paul repeats one verb, "to seem, to be thought", for the Jerusalem leaders (m3), keeping a certain distance without mockery. French keeps the repeated "considérer" at Literal and Balanced so the reader can follow it through 2:6 and 2:9.

decisions.choice: "유력해 보이는 사람들" (L); "지도자로 인정받는 사람들" (B); "지도자로 여겨지는 사람들" (R), here and in verses 6 and 9
decisions.reason: The phrase means those regarded as important, the recognized leaders (the meaning decision). Literal keeps "seem" with "보이는"; Balanced and Readable say who they were, in the same words each time the phrase returns.

decisions.choice: "chạy ... luống công" (L); "chạy ... cách vô ích" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep Paul's picture of a runner in a race; Readable says what it means, his work, as the English Readable does (m4). "Luống công" is effort spent for nothing.

decisions.choice: "họ", "những người được xem là lãnh đạo" for the Jerusalem leaders
decisions.reason: The leaders are spoken of in the third person with the neutral "họ"; "những người có vẻ" keeps the Greek "those who seemed" without irony or contempt (m3).

decisions.choice: os que pareciam [ser líderes] (L); os que eram considerados líderes (B); as pessoas que eram vistas como líderes (R)
decisions.reason: The participle names people held in high regard (m3). "Os que pareciam" keeps Paul's slight distance at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "considerados" and "vistos como", which state their standing without mocking it. The same wording returns in verses 6 and 9.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर ने मुझ पर प्रकट किया था कि मुझे जाना चाहिए" (B); "परमेश्वर ने मुझे दिखाया था" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Balanced and Readable say whose revelation it was and what it was about (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "प्रकाशन" as in 1:12.

decisions.choice: "अन्यजातियों" (L, B); "ग़ैर-यहूदी लोगों" (R)
decisions.reason: The key term for the Gentiles in Paul's letters, as in Romans. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Евангелие (L, B), Радостная весть (R); язычники (L, B), люди других народов (R)
decisions.reason: Key terms of the style guide, as in Romans and Galatians 1.

decisions.choice: "おもだった者と見られている人々" (L); "指導者と見なされている人たち" (B); "指導者と見られていた人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "those who seem", the recognized leaders (m3). Japanese keeps the "seen as" (見られる / 見なされる) that Paul repeats in verses 6 and 9, without irony and without praise.

decisions.choice: "走る" kept (L, B); "働き" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul's picture of a runner in a race stays at Literal and Balanced, where Japanese readers can follow it; Readable says plainly that it is his work, past and present, as the English does.

source.text: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Τίτος ὁ σὺν ἐμοί, Ἕλλην ὤν, ἠναγκάσθη περιτμηθῆναι·

records.literal_gloss: But not even Titus the [one] with me, a Greek being, was compelled to be circumcised;

en.L: But not even Titus, who [was] with me, though he was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
en.B: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was forced to be circumcised, though he was a Greek.
en.R: Titus was with me, and he was a Greek, not a Jew. Yet even he was not forced to be circumcised.

es.L: Pero ni siquiera Tito, que [estaba] conmigo, siendo griego, fue obligado a circuncidarse.
es.B: Sin embargo, ni siquiera Tito, que estaba conmigo, fue obligado a circuncidarse, aunque era griego.
es.R: Tito estaba conmigo, y era griego, no judío. Aun así, ni siquiera a él lo obligaron a circuncidarse.

sw.L: Lakini hata Tito aliyekuwa pamoja nami, akiwa Mgiriki, hakulazimishwa kutahiriwa.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, hata Tito, aliyekuwa pamoja nami, hakulazimishwa kutahiriwa, ingawa alikuwa Mgiriki.
sw.R: Tito alikuwa pamoja nami, naye alikuwa Mgiriki, si Myahudi. Hata hivyo, hata yeye hakulazimishwa kutahiriwa.

fr.L: Mais pas même Tite, qui [était] avec moi, et qui était grec, n’a été contraint de se faire circoncire.
fr.B: Pourtant, même Tite, qui était avec moi, n’a pas été obligé de se faire circoncire, alors qu’il était grec.
fr.R: Tite était avec moi, et il était grec, pas juif. Pourtant, même lui n’a pas été obligé de se faire circoncire.

ko.L: 그러나 나와 함께 있던 디도조차도, 그가 그리스 사람이었는데도, 억지로 할례를 받게 되지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 나와 함께 있던 디도는 그리스 사람이었는데도, 할례를 받으라는 강요를 받지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 디도는 나와 함께 있었고, 유대인이 아니라 그리스 사람이었습니다. 그런데도 그에게 할례를 받으라고 강요하는 사람은 없었습니다.

vi.L: Nhưng ngay cả Tít, người ở với tôi, dù là người Hy Lạp, cũng không bị buộc phải chịu cắt bì.
vi.B: Thế mà ngay cả Tít, người cùng đi với tôi, dù là người Hy Lạp, cũng không bị ép phải chịu cắt bì.
vi.R: Tít đi với tôi, và anh ấy là người Hy Lạp, không phải người Do Thái. Thế mà ngay cả anh ấy cũng không bị ép phải chịu cắt bì.

pt.L: Mas nem mesmo Tito, que [estava] comigo, sendo grego, foi obrigado a ser circuncidado.
pt.B: Mas nem Tito, que estava comigo, foi forçado a ser circuncidado, embora fosse grego.
pt.R: Tito estava comigo, e ele era grego, não judeu. Mesmo assim, ele não foi obrigado a ser circuncidado.

am.L: ነገር ግን ከእኔ ጋር የነበረው ቲቶ እንኳ፣ ግሪካዊ ሆኖ ሳለ፣ እንዲገረዝ አልተገደደም።
am.B: ይሁን እንጂ ከእኔ ጋር የነበረው ቲቶ እንኳ ግሪካዊ ቢሆንም እንዲገረዝ አልተገደደም።
am.R: ቲቶ ከእኔ ጋር ነበር፤ እርሱም አይሁዳዊ ሳይሆን ግሪካዊ ነበር። ቢሆንም እርሱ እንኳ እንዲገረዝ አልተገደደም።

hi.L: पर तीतुस भी, जो मेरे साथ था, यूनानी होते हुए भी ख़तना कराने के लिए विवश नहीं किया गया।
hi.B: फिर भी तीतुस को भी, जो मेरे साथ था, ख़तना कराने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया गया, यद्यपि वह यूनानी था।
hi.R: तीतुस मेरे साथ था, और वह यूनानी था, यहूदी नहीं। फिर भी उसे ख़तना कराने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया गया।

ru.L: Но даже Тит, [бывший] со мной, хотя был грек, не был принуждён обрезаться.
ru.B: Но даже Тита, который был со мной, не заставили обрезаться, хотя он был грек.
ru.R: Со мной был Тит, а он грек, не иудей. И всё же даже его не заставили сделать обрезание.

ja.L: しかし、わたしと共にいたテトスでさえ、ギリシア人であったのに、割礼を受けるよう強いられませんでした。
ja.B: しかし、わたしと一緒にいたテトスも、ギリシア人でしたが、割礼を受けるよう強制されることはありませんでした。
ja.R: テトスはわたしといっしょにいました。テトスはギリシア人で、ユダヤ人ではありません。それでも、テトスでさえ、割礼を受けるようにと無理強いされることはありませんでした。

uk.L: Але навіть Тита, що [був] зі мною, хоч він був грек, не змусили обрізатися.
uk.B: Проте навіть Тита, який був зі мною, не змусили обрізатися, хоч він був грек.
uk.R: Тит був зі мною, і він був грек, а не юдей. Проте навіть його не змусили обрізатися.

decisions.choice: a Greek: a Gentile, someone who was not a Jew
decisions.reason: Paul often sets Ἕλλην against "Jew" to mean any Gentile (3:28; Romans 1:16). What matters here is not where Titus came from but that he was not Jewish and had not been circumcised.

decisions.choice: circumcision: the sign of God's covenant with Abraham, required of every male who joined Israel
decisions.reason: God gave circumcision to Abraham as the sign of the covenant (Genesis 17:10-14), and a Gentile man who became a Jew was circumcised. The question in Galatians is whether Gentiles who believe in Christ must also be circumcised (5:2-3; 6:12-13; Acts 15:1, 5).

decisions.choice: Titus was not circumcised: the leaders did not require it
alternatives: Titus was circumcised, but of his own free will and not under compulsion
decisions.reason: οὐδὲ ("not even") and the next verses, where Paul refuses to give way even for a moment, show that Titus stayed uncircumcised. The other reading leans on the word "compelled", but it does not fit Paul's argument: if Titus had been circumcised, the case would prove the opposite of what Paul says.

decisions.choice: he was a Greek, not a Jew
decisions.reason: Readable adds "not a Jew" to show why it mattered that Titus was a Greek (m1).

decisions.choice: "그리스 사람" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Romans: "헬라인" is the older church word; the Korean style guide gives "그리스 사람", the current word. Readable adds "유대인이 아니라", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "chịu cắt bì" for circumcision, through the letter
decisions.reason: "Cắt bì" is the established Protestant word for the covenant sign (m2), as in the Vietnamese Colossians (2:11) and Romans; the medical phrase would turn the sign into a procedure. "Anh ấy" for Titus, a younger fellow worker, as the Vietnamese Colossians speaks of Tychicus.

decisions.choice: መገረዝ (to be circumcised; circumcision), here and through the letter; አለመገረዝ (uncircumcision)
decisions.reason: "መገረዝ" is the plain current word for the rite, both as a verb and as a noun, and its negative "አለመገረዝ" can stand for Paul's word "uncircumcision". "ግዝረት" is the older church noun and has no matching word for the uncircumcised.

decisions.choice: "割礼" at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: "割礼" is the everyday Japanese word for the rite (m2), written with Jōyō kanji, so Readable keeps it too. The groups called "the circumcision" and "the uncircumcision" are rendered by level (2:7-9, 2:12).

source.text: διὰ δὲ τοὺς παρεισάκτους ψευδαδέλφους, οἵτινες παρεισῆλθον κατασκοπῆσαι τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ἡμῶν ἣν ἔχομεν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα ἡμᾶς καταδουλώσουσιν οἷς οὐδὲ πρὸς ὥραν εἴξαμεν τῇ ὑποταγῇ, ἵνα ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐαγγελίου διαμείνῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Because of and the secretly brought in false brothers, who slipped in to spy out the freedom of us which we have in Christ Jesus, so that us they will enslave, \v 5 to whom not even for an hour we yielded in the submission, so that the truth of the gospel might remain with you.

en.L: But because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who slipped in to spy out our freedom that we have in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, so that they might enslave us \v 5 —to them we did not yield in submission even for an hour, so that the truth of the gospel might remain with you.
en.B: This came up because of false brothers who had been smuggled in. They slipped in to spy on the freedom we have in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, so that they could make us slaves. \v 5 We did not give in to them, not even for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
en.R: The trouble came from some people who claimed to be believers but were not. They had been brought in secretly. They sneaked in to spy on the freedom we have because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. They wanted to make us slaves. \v 5 But we did not give in to them, not even for a moment. We wanted the truth of the good news to stay with you.

es.L: Pero a causa de los falsos hermanos introducidos a escondidas, que se infiltraron para espiar nuestra libertad que tenemos en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, a fin de esclavizarnos \v 5 —a ellos ni por una hora cedimos en sumisión, para que la verdad del evangelio permaneciera con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Esto surgió a causa de unos falsos hermanos que habían sido introducidos a escondidas. Se infiltraron para espiar la libertad que tenemos en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, con el fin de hacernos esclavos. \v 5 No les cedimos, ni por un momento, para que la verdad del evangelio permaneciera con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: El problema vino de algunas personas que decían ser creyentes, pero no lo eran. Las habían metido en secreto. Se colaron para espiar la libertad que tenemos porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}. Querían hacernos esclavos. \v 5 Pero no les cedimos, ni por un momento. Queríamos que la verdad de la buena noticia se quedara con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Lakini kwa sababu ya ndugu wa uongo walioingizwa kwa siri, ambao walijipenyeza ili kupeleleza uhuru wetu tulio nao katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, ili watufanye watumwa \v 5 —kwao hatukukubali kujitiisha hata kwa saa moja, ili kweli ya Injili idumu kwenu.
sw.B: Jambo hili lilizuka kwa sababu ya ndugu wa uongo walioingizwa kwa siri. Walijipenyeza ili kupeleleza uhuru tulio nao katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, wapate kutufanya watumwa. \v 5 Hatukukubali kuwatii, hata kwa muda mfupi, ili kweli ya Injili iendelee kuwa nanyi.
sw.R: Shida ilitoka kwa watu fulani waliodai kuwa waumini, lakini hawakuwa. Walikuwa wameingizwa kwa siri. Walijipenyeza ili kupeleleza uhuru tulio nao kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Walitaka kutufanya watumwa. \v 5 Lakini hatukukubali kuwatii, hata kwa muda mfupi. Tulitaka kweli ya Habari Njema ibaki nanyi.

fr.L: Mais à cause des faux frères introduits en cachette, qui s’étaient glissés [parmi nous] pour espionner notre liberté, celle que nous avons {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, afin de nous réduire en esclavage, \v 5 — à eux, nous n’avons pas cédé en nous soumettant, pas même une heure, afin que la vérité de l’Évangile demeure pour vous.
fr.B: Cela venait de faux frères qu’on avait fait entrer en cachette. Ils s’étaient glissés parmi nous pour espionner la liberté que nous avons {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, afin de faire de nous des esclaves. \v 5 Nous ne leur avons pas cédé, pas même un instant, pour que la vérité de l’Évangile vous soit conservée.
fr.R: Le problème est venu de certaines personnes qui disaient être des croyants, mais qui ne l’étaient pas. On les avait fait entrer en cachette. Elles s’étaient glissées parmi nous pour espionner la liberté que nous avons parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. Elles voulaient faire de nous des esclaves. \v 5 Mais nous ne leur avons pas cédé, pas même un instant. Nous voulions que la vérité de la bonne nouvelle reste avec vous.

ko.L: [이 일은] 몰래 끌어들인 거짓 형제들 때문이었습니다. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리가 가진 자유를 엿보려고 슬며시 들어온 사람들로, 우리를 종으로 삼으려 하였습니다. \v 5 우리는 그들에게 한순간도 굴복하여 따르지 않았습니다. 복음의 진리가 여러분에게 남아 있게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 이 문제가 생긴 것은 몰래 들어온 거짓 형제들 때문이었습니다. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리가 누리는 자유를 엿보려고 슬며시 끼어들었고, 우리를 노예로 만들려고 했습니다. \v 5 우리는 그들에게 잠시도 굽히지 않았습니다. 복음의 진리가 여러분에게 그대로 남아 있게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 문제는 믿는 사람인 척했지만 사실은 그렇지 않은 몇몇 사람들 때문에 생겼습니다. 그들은 몰래 들어왔습니다. 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속해서 누리는 자유를 엿보려고 슬그머니 끼어든 것입니다. 그들은 우리를 노예로 만들고 싶어 했습니다. \v 5 그러나 우리는 그들에게 잠시도 굽히지 않았습니다. 기쁜 소식의 진리가 여러분에게 그대로 남아 있기를 바랐기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Nhưng vì những anh em giả được lén đưa vào, là những người đã lẻn vào để dò xét sự tự do mà chúng tôi có trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, hầu bắt chúng tôi làm nô lệ, \v 5 chúng tôi đã không nhượng bộ, không thuận phục họ dù chỉ một giờ, để chân lý của Tin Lành được ở lại với anh chị em.
vi.B: Việc này xảy ra vì có những anh em giả đã được lén đưa vào. Họ lẻn vào để dò xét sự tự do mà chúng tôi có trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, để bắt chúng tôi làm nô lệ. \v 5 Chúng tôi đã không nhượng bộ họ, dù chỉ trong giây lát, để chân lý của Tin Lành luôn ở lại với anh chị em.
vi.R: Rắc rối đến từ một số người tự xưng là tín hữu nhưng thật ra không phải. Họ đã được lén đưa vào. Họ lẻn vào để dò xét sự tự do mà chúng tôi có vì chúng tôi thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Họ muốn bắt chúng tôi làm nô lệ. \v 5 Nhưng chúng tôi đã không nhượng bộ họ, dù chỉ trong giây lát. Chúng tôi muốn chân lý của Tin Lành mãi ở lại với anh chị em.

pt.L: Mas, por causa dos falsos irmãos introduzidos às escondidas, que se infiltraram para espionar a nossa liberdade, que temos {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, a fim de nos escravizar \v 5 —a eles não cedemos em submissão nem por uma hora, para que a verdade do evangelho permanecesse com vocês.
pt.B: Isso aconteceu por causa de falsos irmãos que tinham sido introduzidos às escondidas. Eles se infiltraram para espionar a liberdade que temos {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, para nos fazer escravos. \v 5 Não cedemos a eles, nem por um momento, para que a verdade do evangelho continuasse com vocês.
pt.R: O problema veio de algumas pessoas que diziam ser irmãos na fé, mas não eram. Elas tinham sido trazidas às escondidas. Entraram sem ser vistas para espionar a liberdade que temos porque pertencemos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus. Queriam nos fazer escravos. \v 5 Mas não cedemos a elas, nem por um momento. Queríamos que a verdade das boas-novas continuasse com vocês.

am.L: ነገር ግን በስውር ስለ ገቡት ሐሰተኛ ወንድሞች [ነው]፤ እነርሱም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያለንን ነፃነታችንን ሊሰልሉ ሾልከው ገቡ፤ ባሪያዎችም ሊያደርጉን [ፈለጉ]፤ \v 5 ለእነርሱ ግን የወንጌል እውነት ከእናንተ ጋር ጸንቶ እንዲኖር ለአንድ ሰዓት እንኳ በመገዛት እሺ አላልንም።
am.B: ይህ ጉዳይ የተነሣው በስውር ሰርገው በገቡ ሐሰተኛ ወንድሞች ምክንያት ነው። እነርሱም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያለንን ነፃነት ለመሰለል ሾልከው ገቡ፤ ዓላማቸውም ባሪያዎች ሊያደርጉን ነበር። \v 5 እኛ ግን የወንጌል እውነት ከእናንተ ጋር እንዲኖር ለአፍታ እንኳ እሺ አላልናቸውም።
am.R: ችግሩ የመጣው ከአንዳንድ ሰዎች ነው፤ እነርሱ አማኞች ነን ይሉ ነበር፤ ግን አልነበሩም። በስውር እንዲገቡ ተደርገው ነበር። {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ በመሆናችን ያለንን ነፃነት ለመሰለል ሾልከው ገቡ። ባሪያዎች ሊያደርጉን ፈለጉ። \v 5 እኛ ግን ለአፍታ እንኳ እሺ አላልናቸውም። የምሥራቹ እውነት ከእናንተ ጋር እንዲኖር ፈለግን።

hi.L: पर उन चोरी से भीतर लाए गए झूठे भाइयों के कारण, जो हमारी उस स्वतंत्रता की जासूसी करने के लिए चुपके से घुस आए थे जो हमें मसीह यीशु में है, ताकि हमें दास बनाएँ, \v 5 उनके आगे हम अधीन होकर एक घड़ी भर के लिए भी नहीं झुके, ताकि सुसमाचार का सत्य तुम्हारे बीच बना रहे।
hi.B: यह बात उन झूठे भाइयों के कारण उठी जिन्हें चुपके से भीतर ले आया गया था। वे उस स्वतंत्रता की जासूसी करने घुस आए थे जो हमें मसीह यीशु में है, ताकि हमें दास बना लें। \v 5 हम उनके आगे एक पल के लिए भी नहीं झुके, ताकि सुसमाचार का सत्य तुम्हारे लिए बना रहे।
hi.R: परेशानी कुछ ऐसे लोगों से आई जो विश्वासी होने का दावा करते थे, पर थे नहीं। उन्हें चुपके से भीतर लाया गया था। वे चोरी-छिपे घुस आए ताकि उस स्वतंत्रता की जासूसी करें जो हमें इसलिए मिली है कि हम मसीह यीशु के हैं। वे हमें दास बनाना चाहते थे। \v 5 पर हम उनके आगे एक पल के लिए भी नहीं झुके। हम चाहते थे कि सुसमाचार का सच तुम्हारे पास बना रहे।

ru.L: Но из-за тайно введённых лжебратьев, которые проникли высмотреть нашу свободу, которую мы имеем {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, чтобы поработить нас, \v 5 — им мы ни на час не уступили в подчинении, чтобы истина Евангелия осталась у вас.
ru.B: Этот вопрос возник из-за лжебратьев, которых тайно ввели к нам. Они пробрались, чтобы шпионить за нашей свободой, которую мы имеем {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, и сделать нас рабами. \v 5 Мы не уступили им ни на минуту, чтобы истина Евангелия сохранилась для вас.
ru.R: Беда пришла от людей, которые называли себя верующими, но на самом деле ими не были. Их тайно привели к нам. Они пробрались, чтобы шпионить за свободой, которая есть у нас, потому что мы принадлежим {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу. Они хотели сделать нас рабами. \v 5 Но мы не уступили им ни на минуту. Мы хотели, чтобы правда Радостной вести осталась с вами.

ja.L: しかし、ひそかに引き入れられた偽兄弟たち、すなわち、わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって持っている自由をうかがい、わたしたちを奴隷にするために忍び込んで来た者たちのゆえに――\v 5 わたしたちは彼らに、一時も屈服して従うことはしませんでした。福音の真理が、あなたがたのもとに保たれるためです。
ja.B: このことが問題になったのは、ひそかに紛れ込んだ偽兄弟たちのためでした。彼らは、わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれて持っている自由を探るために忍び込み、わたしたちを奴隷にしようとしたのです。\v 5 わたしたちは、ひとときも彼らに譲りませんでした。福音の真理が、あなたがたのもとにいつまでもとどまるためです。
ja.R: 問題を起こしたのは、信仰の仲間のふりをしていたけれども、実はそうではない人たちでした。その人たちは、こっそり連れて来られていました。わたしたちは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされているので、自由を持っています。その人たちは、その自由を探ろうとして忍び込んで来たのです。わたしたちを奴隷にしようとしていたのです。\v 5 しかし、わたしたちは、ほんの少しの間も、その人たちに従いませんでした。本当の良い知らせが、みなさんのもとに残るようにしたかったのです。

uk.L: А через потай уведених фальшивих братів, які прокралися підглядати за нашою свободою, яку ми маємо {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, щоб поневолити нас, \v 5 — їм ми ні на годину не поступилися покорою, щоб істина Євангелія залишилася у вас.
uk.B: Це сталося через фальшивих братів, яких потай привели. Вони прокралися, щоб шпигувати за свободою, яку ми маємо {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, щоб зробити нас рабами. \v 5 Ми не поступилися їм ні на мить, щоб істина Євангелія залишилася з вами.
uk.R: Клопіт спричинили люди, які називали себе віруючими, але не були ними. Їх таємно привели. Вони прокралися, щоб шпигувати за свободою, яку ми маємо, бо належимо {{christos:Христові|Месії}} Ісусу. Вони хотіли зробити нас рабами. \v 5 Але ми не поступилися їм ні на мить. Ми хотіли, щоб правда Доброї звістки залишилася з вами.

decisions.choice: the sentence breaks off: the false brothers are why Titus became a test case
alternatives: "because of" goes with verse 5: because of them we did not yield
decisions.reason: Paul starts with διὰ ("because of") but never finishes the sentence; he turns to what he did about these people. The most likely link is with verse 3: the question of circumcising Titus was pressed because of them. Paul's broken grammar may show how strongly he felt about it.

decisions.choice: people who claimed to belong to the family of believers but did not, and who got in by stealth
alternatives: believers who simply disagreed with Paul
decisions.reason: ψευδάδελφος joins "false" to the word for a brother: in Paul's eyes their claim to be fellow believers was false, because they denied the gospel (1:7). παρείσακτος and παρεισέρχομαι speak of being smuggled in and slipping in, and κατασκοπέω is the word for spying. Paul presents them as infiltrators, whether at the Jerusalem meeting or earlier in Antioch (Acts 15:1).

decisions.choice: freedom in Christ from the law as a way of being accepted by God, against being made slaves under it
decisions.reason: Freedom and slavery are the poles of the whole letter (4:3-9, 4:21-5:1). To require Gentile believers to be circumcised would put them under the law as the condition of belonging to God's people, which Paul calls slavery. The freedom is had "in Christ Jesus", that is, by being joined to him.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "to whom we did not yield"
alternatives: "to whom we yielded for an hour": a few manuscripts leave out "to whom not"
decisions.reason: A few Latin witnesses and some early writers lack οἷς οὐδὲ, which would make Paul say he gave way for a short time. The great majority of Greek manuscripts have the words, and the context, where Paul insists Titus was not compelled, requires the refusal. Reviewers should check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the truth of the gospel: the gospel as it really is, kept for the Galatians
decisions.reason: "The truth of the gospel" (again in verse 14) is the gospel unchanged, against the distortion of 1:7. Paul resisted in Jerusalem for the sake of Gentile believers like the Galatians, so that the gospel would continue with them in its true form.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: false brothers, without a gender setting
decisions.reason: "False brothers" keeps the family word Paul uses (m2). The setting for brothers and sisters is not used here, because these are particular people pressing for circumcision at a meeting, and nothing in the text suggests a mixed group. Readable says what the phrase means: people who claimed to be believers but were not.

decisions.choice: This came up because of (B); The trouble came from (R); because we belong to (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable complete the sentence Paul leaves unfinished (m1), linking it to the question about Titus. Readable says "because we belong to" for "in Christ Jesus" (m3).

decisions.choice: con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
decisions.reason: The chapter's only plural "you" addressed to the Galatians takes the ustedes/vosotros setting used throughout Paul's letters. In verse 14 Paul speaks to Cephas alone, with "tú".

decisions.choice: kwenu (L); nanyi (B, R)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the plural "you" in the pronoun itself ("kwenu", "nanyi"), so the Galatians are plainly addressed without a setting.

decisions.choice: make us slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where slavery is set against freedom: the false brothers wanted to take away "the freedom we have" (m3).

decisions.choice: nous réduire en esclavage (L); faire de nous des esclaves (B, R)
decisions.reason: Slavery is set against "notre liberté" (m3), so every level keeps the word "esclave", as the English does.

decisions.choice: faux frères, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in English: these are particular people at one meeting, and Paul's family word is kept as he uses it (m2).

decisions.choice: "거짓 형제들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in the English: these are particular intruders, and the text gives no sign that women were among them, so Korean keeps "형제들" plain. Readable says what the phrase means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "종으로 삼다" (L); "노예로 만들다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Slavery set against freedom is the point here (the meaning decision on freedom in Christ), so Balanced and Readable say "노예", as the style guide asks where slavery itself is meant; Literal says "종으로 삼다", the verb form of the word, which also says "enslave".

decisions.choice: "anh em giả" (L, B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The phrase names particular intruders whom Paul treats as a group of men (m2); "anh em giả" is the fixed phrase, and an inclusive form would sound like a different expression. Readable says "people who claimed to be believers", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "sự tự do" and "làm nô lệ" at every level
decisions.reason: Freedom is set against slavery under the law (m3), so "nô lệ" stays at every level, under the rule for this word.

decisions.choice: "chân lý của Tin Lành"
decisions.reason: "Chân lý" is the key term for truth in the style guide; "lẽ thật" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: pessoas que diziam ser irmãos na fé, mas não eram
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "claimed to be believers". Portuguese avoids "crentes", which in Brazil means Protestants; "irmãos na fé" keeps Paul's family word (m2).

decisions.choice: nos escravizar (L); nos fazer escravos (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Escravo" at every level here, as the English keeps "slave": the point is slavery set against freedom (m3).

decisions.choice: ነፃነት (freedom), here and through the letter
decisions.reason: Freedom in Christ is a key word of the letter (meaning decision m3), set against being made slaves. "ነፃነት" is the everyday word and pairs with "ነፃ" (free) in 3:28 and 4:22-31; "አርነት" is older and now rare.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "झूठे भाइयों", without a gender span
decisions.reason: As the English: these are particular people who claimed to belong to the family of believers (meaning decision m2), so the brothers-and-sisters span is not used.

decisions.choice: "स्वतंत्रता" ... "दास बनाना"
decisions.reason: Freedom set against slavery runs through the letter (meaning decision m3), so both words stay the same at every level: "स्वतंत्रता" for freedom, "दास" for slave, as in Romans.

decisions.choice: {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе
decisions.reason: The preposition changes with the noun, so it goes inside each option, as in Romans.

decisions.choice: лжебратья, without a gender setting
decisions.reason: As in English: the compound keeps Paul's family word for people who claimed to be believers (m2), and the setting is not used on it.

decisions.choice: the broken sentence kept with "――" before verse 5 (L)
alternatives: a complete sentence, as at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Greek breaks off after the false brothers (m1), as the English Literal shows with a dash. Balanced and Readable supply "このことが問題になった" / "問題を起こした", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "偽兄弟たち" with no gender span (L, B); "信仰の仲間のふりをしていた……人たち" (R); "福音の真理" (L, B), "本当の良い知らせ" (R)
alternatives: "{{gender:偽のきょうだいたち|偽兄弟たち}}"
decisions.reason: As the English, the false brothers have no gender setting (r-en-2): Paul names a group posing as members of the family. Readable says what "the truth of the gospel" means here, the gospel as it really is (m5).

decisions.choice: фальшиві брати (no gender span)
decisions.reason: As the English, no gender span: Paul means particular men who got in by stealth (m2). "Лжебрати" is the old church form; "фальшиві брати" is current.

source.text: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν δοκούντων εἶναί τι ὁποῖοί ποτε ἦσαν οὐδέν μοι διαφέρει· πρόσωπον θεὸς ἀνθρώπου οὐ λαμβάνει ἐμοὶ γὰρ οἱ δοκοῦντες οὐδὲν προσανέθεντο, ἀλλὰ τοὐναντίον ἰδόντες ὅτι πεπίστευμαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἀκροβυστίας καθὼς Πέτρος τῆς περιτομῆς, ὁ γὰρ ἐνεργήσας Πέτρῳ εἰς ἀποστολὴν τῆς περιτομῆς ἐνήργησεν καὶ ἐμοὶ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ γνόντες τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι, Ἰάκωβος καὶ Κηφᾶς καὶ Ἰωάννης, οἱ δοκοῦντες στῦλοι εἶναι, δεξιὰς ἔδωκαν ἐμοὶ καὶ Βαρναβᾷ κοινωνίας, ἵνα ἡμεῖς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς τὴν περιτομήν·

records.literal_gloss: From and those seeming to be something, whatever once they were nothing to me matters; face God of a man not receives; to me for those seeming nothing added, \v 7 but on the contrary having seen that I have been entrusted the gospel of the uncircumcision just as Peter of the circumcision, \v 8 for the [one] having worked in Peter for apostleship of the circumcision worked also in me for the Gentiles, \v 9 and having known the grace the [one] given to me, James and Cephas and John, those seeming pillars to be, right hands gave to me and to Barnabas of fellowship, that we to the Gentiles, they and to the circumcision;

en.L: And from those who seemed to be something (whatever they once were makes no difference to me; God does not receive [the] face of {{gender:a person|a man}}), for to me those who seemed [important] added nothing, \v 7 but on the contrary, seeing that I had been entrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision just as Peter [had been with that] of the circumcision \v 8 (for the one who worked in Peter for [the] apostleship of the circumcision worked also in me for the Gentiles), \v 9 and knowing the grace that had been given to me, James and Cephas and John, who seemed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas right hands of fellowship, that we [should go] to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
en.B: As for those who were regarded as important (what they once were makes no difference to me, since God is not swayed by a person's standing), those leaders added nothing to my message. \v 7 On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel for the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been for the circumcised. \v 8 For God, who was at work in Peter to make him an apostle to the circumcised, was also at work in me for the Gentiles. \v 9 James, Cephas and John, who were regarded as pillars, recognized the grace that had been given to me, and they gave Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship. We agreed that we would go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised.
en.R: The people who were seen as leaders did not add anything to what I preach. What they once were does not matter to me. God does not favor anyone because of their position. \v 7 Instead, they saw that God had trusted me with the good news for people who are not Jews, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had trusted Peter with it for the Jews. \v 8 God was at work in Peter, making him an apostle to the Jews, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was also at work in me, sending me to the Gentiles. \v 9 James, Peter and John were seen as the pillars of the church. They recognized that God had given me this gift of grace. So they shook hands with Barnabas and me as partners. We agreed that we would go to the Gentiles, and they would go to the Jews.

es.L: Y de los que parecían ser algo (lo que hayan sido en otro tiempo nada me importa; Dios no recibe [el] rostro de {{gender:una persona|un hombre}}), pues a mí los que parecían [importantes] nada me añadieron, \v 7 sino, al contrario, viendo que se me había confiado el evangelio de la incircuncisión, así como a Pedro [el] de la circuncisión \v 8 (pues el que actuó en Pedro para [el] apostolado de la circuncisión actuó también en mí para los gentiles), \v 9 y conociendo la gracia que me había sido dada, Santiago y Cefas y Juan, que parecían ser columnas, nos dieron a mí y a Bernabé diestras de comunión, para que nosotros [fuéramos] a los gentiles, y ellos a la circuncisión.
es.B: En cuanto a los que eran tenidos por importantes (lo que hayan sido en otro tiempo no me importa, pues Dios no se deja llevar por la posición de nadie), esos dirigentes no añadieron nada a mi mensaje. \v 7 Al contrario, vieron que se me había confiado el evangelio para los incircuncisos, así como a Pedro para los circuncisos. \v 8 Porque Dios, que actuó en Pedro para hacerlo apóstol de los circuncisos, actuó también en mí para los gentiles. \v 9 Santiago, Cefas y Juan, que eran tenidos por columnas, reconocieron la gracia que se me había dado, y nos dieron a Bernabé y a mí la mano derecha de la comunión. Acordamos que nosotros iríamos a los gentiles, y ellos a los circuncisos.
es.R: Los que eran considerados líderes no añadieron nada a lo que predico. Lo que hayan sido antes no me importa. Dios no favorece a nadie por la posición que tenga. \v 7 Al contrario, vieron que Dios me había confiado la buena noticia para los que no son judíos, así como se la había confiado a Pedro para los judíos. \v 8 Dios actuaba en Pedro, haciéndolo apóstol de los judíos, y también actuaba en mí, enviándome a los gentiles. \v 9 Santiago, Pedro y Juan eran considerados las columnas de la iglesia. Reconocieron que Dios me había dado este don de gracia. Por eso nos dieron la mano a Bernabé y a mí como compañeros. Acordamos que nosotros iríamos a los gentiles, y ellos irían a los judíos.

sw.L: Lakini kutoka kwa wale walioonekana kuwa kitu (vyovyote walivyokuwa zamani, kwangu haileti tofauti; Mungu hapokei uso wa mwanadamu), kwa maana wale walioonekana [kuwa muhimu] hawakuniongezea kitu, \v 7 bali kinyume chake, walipoona kwamba nimekabidhiwa Injili ya kutotahiriwa, kama vile Petro [alivyokabidhiwa ile] ya tohara \v 8 (kwa maana aliyetenda kazi ndani ya Petro kwa ajili ya utume wa tohara alitenda kazi pia ndani yangu kwa ajili ya watu wa mataifa), \v 9 na walipoijua neema niliyopewa, Yakobo na Kefa na Yohana, walioonekana kuwa nguzo, walitupa mimi na Barnaba mikono ya kuume ya ushirika, ili sisi [twende] kwa watu wa mataifa, na wao kwa tohara.
sw.B: Kuhusu wale waliotambulika kuwa watu muhimu (walivyokuwa zamani haileti tofauti kwangu, kwa kuwa Mungu hampendelei mtu kwa sababu ya cheo chake), viongozi hao hawakuongeza chochote kwenye ujumbe wangu. \v 7 Kinyume chake, waliona kwamba nimekabidhiwa Injili kwa ajili ya wasiotahiriwa, kama vile Petro alivyokabidhiwa kwa ajili ya waliotahiriwa. \v 8 Kwa maana Mungu, aliyetenda kazi ndani ya Petro ili kumfanya mtume kwa waliotahiriwa, alitenda kazi pia ndani yangu kwa ajili ya watu wa mataifa. \v 9 Yakobo, Kefa na Yohana, waliotambulika kuwa nguzo, waliitambua neema niliyopewa, wakanipa mimi na Barnaba mkono wa kuume kama ishara ya ushirika. Tulikubaliana kwamba sisi tungeenda kwa watu wa mataifa, na wao kwa waliotahiriwa.
sw.R: Watu waliotambulika kuwa viongozi hawakuongeza chochote kwenye ujumbe ninaohubiri. Walivyokuwa zamani si muhimu kwangu. Mungu hampendelei mtu yeyote kwa sababu ya cheo chake. \v 7 Badala yake, waliona kwamba Mungu alikuwa amenikabidhi Habari Njema kwa ajili ya watu wasio Wayahudi, kama vile alivyomkabidhi Petro kwa ajili ya Wayahudi. \v 8 Mungu alitenda kazi ndani ya Petro, akamfanya mtume kwa Wayahudi, na alitenda kazi pia ndani yangu, akanituma kwa watu wa mataifa. \v 9 Yakobo, Petro na Yohana walitambulika kuwa nguzo za kanisa. Walitambua kwamba Mungu alinipa kipawa hiki cha neema. Kwa hiyo walishikana mikono nami na Barnaba kama washirika. Tulikubaliana kwamba sisi tungeenda kwa watu wa mataifa, na wao wangeenda kwa Wayahudi.

fr.L: Et de la part de ceux qui paraissaient être quelque chose — ce qu’ils étaient autrefois ne m’importe en rien : Dieu ne reçoit pas le visage d’un {{gender:être humain|homme}} —, car à moi, ceux qui étaient considérés [comme importants] n’ont rien ajouté, \v 7 mais au contraire, voyant que l’Évangile de l’incirconcision m’avait été confié, comme à Pierre [celui] de la circoncision \v 8 (car celui qui a agi en Pierre pour l’apostolat de la circoncision a aussi agi en moi pour les nations), \v 9 et reconnaissant la grâce qui m’avait été donnée, Jacques, Céphas et Jean, qui étaient considérés comme des colonnes, nous ont donné, à moi et à Barnabas, la main droite d’association, afin que nous [allions] vers les nations, et eux vers la circoncision.
fr.B: Quant à ceux qu’on considérait comme importants — ce qu’ils étaient autrefois ne m’importe pas, car Dieu ne se laisse pas impressionner par le rang d’une personne —, ces responsables n’ont rien ajouté à mon message. \v 7 Au contraire, ils ont vu que l’Évangile m’avait été confié pour les incirconcis, comme à Pierre pour les circoncis. \v 8 Car Dieu, qui était à l’œuvre en Pierre pour faire de lui l’apôtre des circoncis, était aussi à l’œuvre en moi pour les nations. \v 9 Jacques, Céphas et Jean, qu’on considérait comme des colonnes, ont reconnu la grâce qui m’avait été donnée, et ils nous ont tendu la main droite, à Barnabas et à moi, en signe de communion. Nous sommes convenus que nous irions vers les nations, et eux vers les circoncis.
fr.R: Les gens qu’on voyait comme les chefs n’ont rien ajouté à ce que j’annonce. Ce qu’ils étaient autrefois ne compte pas pour moi. Dieu ne favorise personne à cause de sa position. \v 7 Au contraire, ils ont vu que Dieu m’avait confié la bonne nouvelle pour les non-Juifs, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait confiée à Pierre pour les Juifs. \v 8 Dieu agissait en Pierre pour faire de lui un apôtre envoyé aux Juifs, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} agissait aussi en moi pour m’envoyer vers les non-Juifs. \v 9 Jacques, Pierre et Jean étaient considérés comme les colonnes de l’Église. Ils ont reconnu que Dieu m’avait fait ce don de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce. Alors ils nous ont serré la main, à Barnabas et à moi, comme à des partenaires. Nous sommes tombés d’accord : nous irions vers les non-Juifs, et eux iraient vers les Juifs.

ko.L: 유력해 보이는 사람들에게서는 (그들이 전에 어떤 사람들이었든지 나에게는 아무 상관이 없습니다. 하나님께서는 사람의 얼굴을 받아들이지 않으십니다) 참으로 유력해 보이는 그 사람들이 나에게 더해 준 것이 없었습니다. \v 7 오히려 그들은 베드로가 할례[받은 사람들]의 복음을 [맡은] 것처럼 내가 무할례[인 사람들]의 복음을 맡았다는 것을 보았고, \v 8 (베드로 안에서 일하셔서 할례[받은 사람들]의 사도직을 [주신] 분께서 내 안에서도 일하셔서 이방 사람들에게 [보내셨기] 때문입니다) \v 9 또 나에게 주신 은혜를 알고, 기둥으로 여겨지는 야고보와 게바와 요한이 나와 바나바에게 사귐의 오른손을 내밀었습니다. 우리는 이방 사람들에게로, 그들은 할례[받은 사람들]에게로 [가기로 한 것입니다].
ko.B: 지도자로 인정받는 사람들은 (그들이 전에 어떤 사람들이었든지 나에게는 상관이 없습니다. 하나님께서는 사람의 겉모습을 보고 대하지 않으십니다) 내가 전하는 복음에 아무것도 더하지 않았습니다. \v 7 오히려 그들은 베드로가 할례받은 사람들을 위한 복음을 맡은 것처럼, 내가 할례받지 않은 사람들을 위한 복음을 맡았다는 것을 알았습니다. \v 8 베드로 안에서 일하셔서 그를 할례받은 사람들의 사도로 세우신 하나님께서, 내 안에서도 일하셔서 나를 이방 사람들에게 보내셨기 때문입니다. \v 9 그래서 기둥으로 인정받는 야고보와 게바와 요한은 나에게 주신 은혜를 알아보고, 나와 바나바에게 오른손을 내밀어 사귐의 악수를 나누었습니다. 우리는 이방 사람들에게로 가고, 그들은 할례받은 사람들에게로 가기로 했습니다.
ko.R: 지도자로 여겨지는 사람들은 내가 전하는 기쁜 소식에 아무것도 더하지 않았습니다. 그들이 전에 어떤 사람들이었는지는 나에게 중요하지 않습니다. 하나님께서는 지위를 보고 누구를 더 좋게 대하지 않으십니다. \v 7 오히려 그들은 하나님께서 베드로에게 유대인을 위한 기쁜 소식을 맡기신 것처럼, 나에게는 유대인이 아닌 사람들을 위한 기쁜 소식을 맡기셨다는 것을 알게 되었습니다. \v 8 하나님께서 베드로 안에서 일하셔서 그를 유대인에게 보내는 사도로 삼으셨고, 내 안에서도 일하셔서 나를 유대인이 아닌 사람들에게 보내셨습니다. \v 9 야고보와 베드로와 요한은 교회의 기둥으로 여겨지는 사람들이었습니다. 그들은 하나님께서 나에게 이 은혜의 선물을 주셨다는 것을 알았습니다. 그래서 그들은 바나바와 나에게 동역자로서 악수를 청했습니다. 우리는 유대인이 아닌 사람들에게로 가고, 그들은 유대인에게로 가기로 합의했습니다.

vi.L: Còn về những người có vẻ là quan trọng (trước kia họ là thế nào cũng chẳng can hệ gì đến tôi; Đức Chúa Trời không xem bề ngoài của người ta), thì những người có vẻ [quan trọng] ấy đã không thêm điều gì cho tôi, \v 7 nhưng trái lại, khi thấy rằng tôi đã được giao phó Tin Lành cho những người không cắt bì, cũng như Phi-e-rơ [đã được giao phó Tin Lành] cho những người cắt bì \v 8 (vì Đấng đã hành động trong Phi-e-rơ cho chức sứ đồ giữa những người cắt bì, cũng đã hành động trong tôi cho các dân ngoại), \v 9 và khi biết ân điển đã được ban cho tôi, thì Gia-cơ, Sê-pha và Giăng, là những người có vẻ là trụ cột, đã đưa tay phải cho tôi và Ba-na-ba để tỏ sự thông công, để chúng tôi [đi] đến với các dân ngoại, còn họ đến với những người cắt bì.
vi.B: Còn về những người được xem là quan trọng (trước kia họ là ai cũng không quan trọng đối với tôi, vì Đức Chúa Trời không thiên vị theo địa vị của người ta), những vị lãnh đạo ấy đã không thêm điều gì vào sứ điệp của tôi. \v 7 Trái lại, họ thấy rằng tôi đã được giao phó Tin Lành cho những người không cắt bì, cũng như Phi-e-rơ đã được giao phó cho những người cắt bì. \v 8 Vì Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã hành động trong Phi-e-rơ để lập ông làm sứ đồ cho những người cắt bì, cũng đã hành động trong tôi cho các dân ngoại. \v 9 Gia-cơ, Sê-pha và Giăng, là những người được xem là trụ cột, đã nhận ra ân điển đã được ban cho tôi, và họ bắt tay phải với Ba-na-ba và tôi để tỏ sự thông công. Chúng tôi đồng ý rằng chúng tôi sẽ đến với các dân ngoại, còn họ đến với những người cắt bì.
vi.R: Những người được xem là lãnh đạo đã không thêm điều gì vào những gì tôi rao giảng. Trước kia họ là ai thì cũng không quan trọng đối với tôi. Đức Chúa Trời không ưu đãi ai vì địa vị của người ấy. \v 7 Trái lại, họ thấy rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã tin cậy giao cho tôi Tin Lành cho những người không phải là người Do Thái, cũng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tin cậy giao cho Phi-e-rơ Tin Lành cho người Do Thái. \v 8 Đức Chúa Trời đã hành động trong Phi-e-rơ, lập ông làm sứ đồ cho người Do Thái, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã hành động trong tôi, sai tôi đến với các dân ngoại. \v 9 Gia-cơ, Phi-e-rơ và Giăng được xem là những trụ cột của Hội Thánh. Họ nhận ra rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho tôi ân điển này. Vì vậy họ bắt tay Ba-na-ba và tôi như những người cùng chung công việc. Chúng tôi đồng ý rằng chúng tôi sẽ đến với các dân ngoại, còn họ sẽ đến với người Do Thái.

pt.L: E, da parte dos que pareciam ser alguma coisa (o que eles eram outrora não me faz diferença; Deus não recebe [a] face de {{gender:uma pessoa|um homem}}), pois a mim os que pareciam [importantes] nada acrescentaram, \v 7 mas, pelo contrário, vendo que me tinha sido confiado o evangelho da incircuncisão, assim como a Pedro [o] da circuncisão \v 8 (pois aquele que atuou em Pedro para [o] apostolado da circuncisão atuou também em mim para as nações), \v 9 e conhecendo a graça que me tinha sido dada, Tiago, Cefas e João, que pareciam ser colunas, deram a mim e a Barnabé [as] mãos direitas de comunhão, para que nós [fôssemos] às nações, e eles à circuncisão.
pt.B: Quanto aos que eram considerados importantes (o que eles foram um dia não faz diferença para mim, porque Deus não se deixa levar pela posição de ninguém), esses líderes nada acrescentaram à minha mensagem. \v 7 Pelo contrário, viram que a mim tinha sido confiado o evangelho para os incircuncisos, assim como a Pedro, para os circuncidados. \v 8 Pois Deus, que agiu em Pedro para fazer dele apóstolo dos circuncidados, também agiu em mim para me enviar aos não judeus. \v 9 Tiago, Cefas e João, que eram considerados colunas, reconheceram a graça que me tinha sido dada e deram a Barnabé e a mim a mão direita, em sinal de comunhão. Combinamos que nós iríamos aos não judeus, e eles, aos circuncidados.
pt.R: As pessoas que eram vistas como líderes não acrescentaram nada ao que eu anuncio. O que eles foram um dia não importa para mim. Deus não trata ninguém melhor por causa da posição que a pessoa tem. \v 7 Pelo contrário, eles viram que Deus tinha confiado a mim as boas-novas para as pessoas que não são judias, assim como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha confiado a Pedro as boas-novas para os judeus. \v 8 Deus agiu em Pedro, fazendo dele apóstolo dos judeus, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também agiu em mim e me enviou aos não judeus. \v 9 Tiago, Pedro e João eram vistos como as colunas da Igreja. Eles reconheceram a graça que Deus tinha me dado. Por isso apertaram a mão de Barnabé e a minha, como sinal de que éramos parceiros. Combinamos que nós iríamos aos não judeus, e eles iriam aos judeus.

am.L: አንድ ነገር ከሚመስሉት ግን (ቀድሞ ምንም ቢሆኑ ለእኔ ምንም ልዩነት የለውም፤ እግዚአብሔር የሰውን ፊት አይቀበልም)፣ [መሪዎች] የሚመስሉት ለእኔ ምንም አልጨመሩልኝምና፤ \v 7 ነገር ግን በተቃራኒው፣ ጴጥሮስ የመገረዝን [ወንጌል] አደራ እንደ ተሰጠው፣ የአለመገረዝ ወንጌል ለእኔ አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ አይተው፣ \v 8 (ለመገረዝ ሐዋርያነት በጴጥሮስ የሠራው በእኔም ደግሞ ለአሕዛብ ሠርቷልና)፣ \v 9 የተሰጠኝንም ጸጋ አውቀው፣ ዓምዶች መስለው የሚታዩት ያዕቆብና ኬፋ ዮሐንስም፣ እኛ ወደ አሕዛብ፣ እነርሱም ወደ መገረዝ [ወገን] [እንድንሄድ]፣ ለእኔና ለበርናባስ የኅብረትን ቀኝ እጅ ሰጡ።
am.B: መሪዎች ተብለው የሚታወቁትን በተመለከተ (ቀድሞ ምን እንደ ነበሩ ለእኔ ምንም ለውጥ አያመጣም፤ እግዚአብሔር በሰው ማዕረግ አያዳላምና)፣ እነዚያ መሪዎች በመልእክቴ ላይ ምንም አልጨመሩም። \v 7 ይልቁንም ጴጥሮስ ለተገረዙት ወንጌልን አደራ እንደ ተሰጠው፣ እኔም ላልተገረዙት ወንጌልን አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ አዩ። \v 8 ጴጥሮስ ለተገረዙት ሐዋርያ እንዲሆን በእርሱ የሠራው እግዚአብሔር ለአሕዛብም በእኔ ሠርቷልና። \v 9 ዓምዶች ተብለው የሚታወቁት ያዕቆብ፣ ኬፋና ዮሐንስ የተሰጠኝን ጸጋ ተገነዘቡ፤ ለእኔና ለበርናባስም የኅብረትን ቀኝ እጅ ሰጡን። እኛ ወደ አሕዛብ፣ እነርሱም ወደ ተገረዙት እንድንሄድ ተስማማን።
am.R: መሪዎች ተብለው የሚታዩት ሰዎች በምሰብከው ላይ ምንም አልጨመሩም። ቀድሞ ምን እንደ ነበሩ ለእኔ ጉዳዬ አይደለም። እግዚአብሔር ማንንም በማዕረጉ ምክንያት አያዳላም። \v 7 ይልቁንም እግዚአብሔር ለአይሁድ የሚሆነውን የምሥራች ለጴጥሮስ በአደራ እንደ ሰጠው፣ አይሁድ ላልሆኑ ሕዝቦች የሚሆነውን የምሥራች ደግሞ ለእኔ በአደራ እንደ ሰጠኝ አዩ። \v 8 እግዚአብሔር ጴጥሮስን ለአይሁድ ሐዋርያ አድርጎ በእርሱ ይሠራ ነበር፤ እኔንም አይሁድ ወዳልሆኑ ሕዝቦች እየላከ በእኔ ይሠራ ነበር። \v 9 ያዕቆብ፣ ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ዓምዶች ተብለው ይታዩ ነበር። እግዚአብሔር ይህን የጸጋ ስጦታ እንደ ሰጠኝ ተገነዘቡ። ስለዚህ ከበርናባስና ከእኔ ጋር እንደ ባልደረቦች እጅ ተጨባበጡ። እኛ አይሁድ ወዳልሆኑ ሕዝቦች፣ እነርሱም ወደ አይሁድ እንድንሄድ ተስማማን።

hi.L: और जो कुछ समझे जाते थे, उनसे (वे पहले चाहे जैसे भी थे, मुझे उससे कुछ अंतर नहीं पड़ता; परमेश्वर मनुष्य का मुँह नहीं देखते), क्योंकि जो [बड़े] समझे जाते थे, उन्होंने मेरे [संदेश] में कुछ नहीं जोड़ा, \v 7 परंतु इसके विपरीत, यह देखकर कि ख़तनारहितों का सुसमाचार मुझे सौंपा गया था, जैसे ख़तनावालों का पतरस को \v 8 (क्योंकि जिन्होंने ख़तनावालों की प्रेरिताई के लिए पतरस में कार्य किया, उन्होंने अन्यजातियों के लिए मुझमें भी कार्य किया), \v 9 और उस अनुग्रह को जानकर जो मुझे दिया गया था, याकूब और केफ़ा और यूहन्ना ने, जो खंभे समझे जाते थे, मुझे और बरनबास को संगति का दाहिना हाथ दिया, कि हम अन्यजातियों के पास [जाएँ], और वे ख़तनावालों के पास।
hi.B: जो लोग बड़े माने जाते थे (वे पहले क्या थे, इससे मुझे कोई अंतर नहीं पड़ता, क्योंकि परमेश्वर किसी का पद देखकर पक्षपात नहीं करते), उन अगुवों ने मेरे संदेश में कुछ नहीं जोड़ा। \v 7 इसके विपरीत, उन्होंने देखा कि ख़तनारहितों के लिए सुसमाचार मुझे सौंपा गया है, जैसे ख़तना किए हुओं के लिए पतरस को। \v 8 क्योंकि परमेश्वर, जिन्होंने पतरस को ख़तना किए हुओं का प्रेरित बनाने के लिए उसमें कार्य किया, उन्होंने अन्यजातियों के लिए मुझमें भी कार्य किया। \v 9 याकूब, केफ़ा और यूहन्ना ने, जो खंभे माने जाते थे, उस अनुग्रह को पहचाना जो मुझे दिया गया था, और उन्होंने मुझे और बरनबास को संगति का दाहिना हाथ दिया। हम सहमत हुए कि हम अन्यजातियों के पास जाएँगे और वे ख़तना किए हुओं के पास।
hi.R: जो लोग अगुवे माने जाते थे, उन्होंने मेरे प्रचार में कुछ नहीं जोड़ा। वे पहले क्या थे, इससे मुझे कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता। परमेश्वर किसी का पद देखकर उसका पक्ष नहीं लेते। \v 7 इसके बजाय, उन्होंने देखा कि परमेश्वर ने ग़ैर-यहूदी लोगों के लिए सुसमाचार मुझे सौंपा है, जैसे उन्होंने यहूदियों के लिए उसे पतरस को सौंपा था। \v 8 परमेश्वर पतरस में कार्य कर रहे थे और उसे यहूदियों का प्रेरित बना रहे थे, और वे मुझमें भी कार्य कर रहे थे और मुझे ग़ैर-यहूदी लोगों के पास भेज रहे थे। \v 9 याकूब, पतरस और यूहन्ना कलीसिया के खंभे माने जाते थे। उन्होंने पहचान लिया कि परमेश्वर ने मुझे अनुग्रह का यह वरदान दिया है। इसलिए उन्होंने साथी मानकर मुझसे और बरनबास से हाथ मिलाया। हम सहमत हुए कि हम ग़ैर-यहूदी लोगों के पास जाएँगे, और वे यहूदियों के पास जाएँगे।

ru.L: А от тех, кто считался чем-то (какими они когда-то были, мне нет разницы: Бог не смотрит на лицо человека), — мне ведь те, кто считался [важными], ничего не добавили, \v 7 но, напротив, увидев, что мне вверено Евангелие для необрезанных, как Петру — для обрезанных, \v 8 (ведь действовавший в Петре для апостольства у обрезанных действовал и во мне для язычников), \v 9 и узнав благодать, данную мне, Иаков, и Кифа, и Иоанн, которых считали столпами, подали мне и Варнаве правую руку общения, чтобы мы [шли] к язычникам, а они — к обрезанным.
ru.B: Что же касается тех, кого считали важными (какими они когда-то были, для меня не имеет значения: Бог не судит по положению человека), то эти руководители ничего не добавили к моей вести. \v 7 Напротив, они увидели, что мне вверено Евангелие для необрезанных, как Петру — для обрезанных. \v 8 Ведь Бог, который действовал в Петре, сделав его апостолом для обрезанных, действовал и во мне ради язычников. \v 9 Иаков, Кифа и Иоанн, которых считали столпами, признали благодать, данную мне, и подали мне и Варнаве правую руку в знак общения. Мы договорились, что мы пойдём к язычникам, а они — к обрезанным.
ru.R: Люди, которых считали руководителями, ничего не добавили к тому, что я проповедую. Кем они были раньше, для меня не важно. Бог никому не оказывает предпочтения из-за его положения. \v 7 Наоборот, они увидели, что Бог доверил мне Радостную весть для тех, кто не иудей, так же как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} доверил её Петру для иудеев. \v 8 Бог действовал в Петре, сделав его апостолом для иудеев, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} же действовал во мне, посылая меня к другим народам. \v 9 Иаков, Пётр и Иоанн считались столпами церкви. Они признали, что Бог дал мне этот дар благодати. Поэтому они пожали руки мне и Варнаве как своим товарищам. Мы договорились, что мы пойдём к другим народам, а они — к иудеям.

ja.L: さて、何者かであると思われていた人々から[は]――彼らがかつてどのような者であったにせよ、わたしには何の違いもありません。神は人の顔[を見て、その人]を受け入れられることはないのです――、というのは、おもだった人々は、わたしに何も付け加えなかったのです。\v 7 それどころか反対に、ペトロが割礼の[者への]福音を委ねられているように、わたしが無割礼の[者への]福音を委ねられていることを見て、\v 8 ――ペトロのうちに働いて割礼の[者への]使徒職へと[導かれた]方は、わたしのうちにも働いて異邦人へと[導かれた]からです――、\v 9 また、わたしに与えられた恵みを知って、柱と思われていたヤコブとケファとヨハネは、わたしとバルナバに交わりの右手を与えました。わたしたちは異邦人へ、彼らは割礼の[者たち]へ[行く]ためです。
ja.B: おもだった人々と見なされていた人たちについて言えば――彼らがかつてどのような人であったかは、わたしには関係のないことです。神は人を、その立場によって分け隔てなさらないからです――、その指導者たちは、わたしの伝える福音に何も付け加えませんでした。\v 7 それどころか、彼らは、ペトロが割礼を受けた人々への福音を委ねられているように、わたしが割礼を受けていない人々への福音を委ねられていることを認めました。\v 8 ペトロのうちに働いて、彼を割礼を受けた人々への使徒とされた神は、わたしのうちにも働いて、わたしを異邦人に遣わされたのです。\v 9 そして、柱と見なされていたヤコブとケファとヨハネは、わたしに与えられた恵みを認め、わたしとバルナバに、交わりのしるしとして右手を差し出しました。こうして、わたしたちは異邦人のところへ、彼らは割礼を受けた人々のところへ行くことになったのです。
ja.R: 指導者と見られていた人たちは、わたしが伝えていることに何も付け加えませんでした。その人たちが以前どんな人だったかは、わたしにとって問題ではありません。神は、地位によってだれかをひいきしたりはなさいません。\v 7 それどころか、その人たちは、神がペトロにユダヤ人のための良い知らせを任せられたように、わたしにはユダヤ人でない人々のための良い知らせを任せてくださったことを見て取りました。\v 8 神はペトロのうちに働いて、ペトロをユダヤ人への使徒とされました。同じ神が、わたしのうちにも働いて、わたしをユダヤ人でない人々のところへ送り出してくださったのです。\v 9 ヤコブ、ペトロ、ヨハネは、教会の柱と見られていた人たちです。その人たちは、神がわたしにこの恵みの贈り物を与えてくださったことを認めました。そして、仲間のしるしとして、バルナバとわたしと握手をしてくれました。わたしたちはユダヤ人でない人々のところへ行き、その人たちはユダヤ人のところへ行くことに決めたのです。

uk.L: А від тих, що вважалися чимось (якими вони колись були, мені байдуже; Бог не зважає на обличчя людини), — бо мені ті, що вважалися [важливими], нічого не додали, \v 7 але, навпаки, побачивши, що мені доручено Євангеліє для необрізаних, як Петрові — для обрізаних \v 8 (бо той, хто діяв у Петрі для апостольства серед обрізаних, діяв і в мені для язичників), \v 9 і пізнавши благодать, дану мені, Яків, і Кифа, і Іван, які вважалися стовпами, подали мені й Варнаві правиці спільності, щоб ми [йшли] до язичників, а вони — до обрізаних.
uk.B: Щодо тих, кого вважали важливими (якими вони колись були, для мене не має значення, бо Бог не зважає на становище людини), ці провідники нічого не додали до моєї звістки. \v 7 Навпаки, вони побачили, що мені доручено Євангеліє для необрізаних, як Петрові — для обрізаних. \v 8 Бо Бог, який діяв у Петрі, зробивши його апостолом для обрізаних, діяв і в мені для язичників. \v 9 Яків, Кифа та Іван, яких уважали стовпами, визнали благодать, дану мені, і подали мені й Варнаві правицю спільності. Ми домовилися, що підемо до язичників, а вони — до обрізаних.
uk.R: Люди, яких уважали провідниками, нічого не додали до того, що я проповідую. Якими вони колись були, для мене неважливо. Бог не віддає переваги нікому через його становище. \v 7 Навпаки, вони побачили, що Бог довірив мені Добру звістку для людей, які не є юдеями, так само як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} довірив її Петрові для юдеїв. \v 8 Бог діяв у Петрі, зробивши його апостолом для юдеїв, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} діяв також у мені, пославши мене до неюдеїв. \v 9 Якова, Петра та Івана вважали стовпами церкви. Вони визнали, що Бог дав мені цей дар благодаті. Тож вони потиснули руки мені й Варнаві як спільникам. Ми домовилися, що підемо до неюдеїв, а вони — до юдеїв.

decisions.choice: the sentence breaks off and starts again: "from those who seemed" is picked up by "for to me those who seemed added nothing"
alternatives: a smooth sentence with no break
decisions.reason: Paul begins with ἀπὸ ("from"), stops to say that their standing makes no difference to him, and then begins again with ἐμοὶ γὰρ ("for to me"). The middle words are an aside. The aside and the restart both serve one point: the leaders took nothing from and added nothing to Paul's gospel.

decisions.choice: those regarded as important, the recognized leaders, here named as James, Cephas and John
decisions.reason: Paul repeats δοκέω ("those who seem") from verse 2, and in verse 9 adds "to be pillars". He accepts their standing and their agreement, but he will not treat their reputation as the measure of the gospel. The repeated word keeps that distance without mockery.

decisions.choice: whatever they once were: perhaps their having been with Jesus during his ministry
alternatives: whatever they are now, their present rank
decisions.reason: ποτε usually means "once, formerly". Paul may be thinking of what gave these men their standing, such as having known Jesus in his earthly life, or of James being the Lord's brother (1:19). It could also simply mean "whatever they were". The point is unchanged: their past or rank does not decide what the gospel is.

decisions.choice: God does not show favor according to a person's outward standing
alternatives: God does not look at people's faces
decisions.reason: To "receive the face" is a Hebrew way of saying to show partiality, to favor someone for their rank or appearance. The Law forbids it to judges and says God does not do it (Leviticus 19:15; Deuteronomy 10:17). θεὸς is the subject, and ἀνθρώπου means any human being.

decisions.choice: added nothing: required nothing more of Paul and corrected nothing in his gospel
decisions.reason: προσανατίθημι is the verb of 1:16, where Paul did not "consult" anyone. Here, with "nothing", it means the leaders laid no further demand on him, such as circumcision for his Gentile converts, and did not add anything to what he preached.

decisions.choice: entrusted with: God had given Paul the gospel to carry, as a trust
decisions.reason: πεπίστευμαι is a passive of the verb that usually means "believe". With an object it means to be entrusted with something (1 Thessalonians 2:4; 1 Timothy 1:11). The passive leaves God as the one who gave the trust, as verse 8 makes plain.

decisions.choice: one gospel taken to two peoples: the uncircumcised (Gentiles) and the circumcised (Jews)
decisions.reason: "The uncircumcision" and "the circumcision" are ways of naming Gentiles and Jews by the mark that divided them. "The gospel of" each means the gospel as taken to each people. Paul has already said there is no other gospel (1:6-7); the difference is the field of mission, not the message.

decisions.choice: the one who worked in Peter and in Paul is God
decisions.reason: ὁ ἐνεργήσας ("the one who worked") does not name the subject, but in Paul the one who works in his servants is God (1:15-16; 1 Corinthians 12:6; Philippians 2:13). The same God made Peter an apostle to the Jews and Paul to the Gentiles.

decisions.choice: James the Lord's brother; Cephas, that is, Peter; John the son of Zebedee
decisions.reason: James is the brother of the Lord mentioned in 1:19, who led the Jerusalem church (Acts 15:13; 21:18). Κηφᾶς is the Aramaic name Jesus gave Simon, meaning "rock"; Peter is the Greek form (John 1:42). Paul uses both names in these verses for the same man. John is one of the Twelve, the son of Zebedee.

decisions.choice: pillars: the main supports of God's people; right hands of fellowship: a handshake sealing a partnership
alternatives: right hands as a sign of submission
decisions.reason: A pillar holds up a building, and God's people are sometimes pictured as his house or temple (1 Corinthians 3:16; 1 Timothy 3:15). Giving the right hand was a pledge of agreement between equals. κοινωνίας is the word for sharing and partnership: the leaders recognized Paul and Barnabas as partners in the one work.

decisions.choice: an agreement about where each would work: Paul and Barnabas among Gentiles, the others among Jews
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves out the verb: "that we to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision". The division is by people rather than by region; Paul still preached in synagogues, and Peter later ate with Gentiles in Antioch (verse 12).

decisions.choice: Cephas (L, B); Peter (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the name Paul uses here; Readable uses "Peter", the name readers know, since it is the same man (m9) and verses 7-8 already call him Peter.

decisions.choice: to my message (B, R); God (B, R in verse 8; R in verse 7); the pillars of the church (R); as partners (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the leaders added nothing to (m5) and name God as the one at work (m8). Readable says who entrusted Paul (m6), what the pillars held up and what the handshake meant (m10).

decisions.choice: receive [the] face of {{gender:a person|a man}} (L); not swayed by a person's standing (B); does not favor anyone because of their position (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom, with the gender setting for a word that means any human being. Balanced and Readable say what it means (m4).

decisions.choice: the aside in verse 6 kept in brackets (B) or made separate sentences (R); verses 7-9 broken into sentences
decisions.reason: Paul's long, broken sentence becomes several English sentences. Readable puts the main point first: the leaders added nothing.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: Pronouns for God follow the reader's setting.

decisions.choice: the uncircumcised, the circumcised (B); people who are not Jews, the Jews (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of circumcision in a natural form; Readable names the two peoples (m7).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun inside the verb ("se la había confiado", "actuaba"), so the free "he" that carries the English setting in verses 7-8 has no Spanish counterpart, and adding "él" would sound emphatic.

decisions.choice: diestras de comunión (L); la mano derecha de la comunión (B)
alternatives: la diestra en señal de compañerismo
decisions.reason: "Comunión" is the usual Spanish word for this Greek word in Paul and keeps the link with sharing and partnership the meaning decision describes. Readable says what the handshake meant: "como compañeros".

decisions.choice: uso wa mwanadamu, no setting
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" is a human being, man or woman, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili, here or elsewhere in the chapter.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Swahili marks "he" inside the verb ("alivyomkabidhi", "alitenda"), and a verb prefix cannot take a capital, so the pronoun setting has no free pronoun to apply to in verses 7-8. Swahili has fewer such spans than English throughout the letter.

decisions.choice: Dieu ne reçoit pas le visage d'un {{gender:être humain|homme}} (L)
alternatives: Dieu ne fait pas acception de personne
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom (m4), as the English Literal does, with the setting on the noun for any human being. The traditional French "faire acception de personne" is no longer understood. Balanced says "le rang d'une personne", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: the aside of verse 6 set between dashes (L, B)
decisions.reason: Paul breaks off and starts again (m1). French marks such an aside with dashes; the parentheses are kept for verse 8, as in the English Literal.

decisions.choice: ils nous ont tendu la main droite ... en signe de communion (B); ils nous ont serré la main ... comme à des partenaires (R)
decisions.reason: Giving the right hand sealed a partnership (m10). "Tendre la main droite" keeps the gesture, and "communion" the word for sharing; Readable says what the handshake meant.

decisions.choice: Literal keeps the broken sentence, with the aside in parentheses and "유력해 보이는 그 사람들" repeated to pick up the thread
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the Greek breaks off and starts again. Korean can show the break by naming the leaders twice, so Literal lets the reader see it; Balanced and Readable write it as plain sentences. Each verse keeps its own content after its marker.

decisions.choice: "사람의 얼굴을 받아들이지 않으십니다" (L); "사람의 겉모습을 보고 대하지 않으십니다" (B); "지위를 보고 누구를 더 좋게 대하지 않으십니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom "receive the face" means to favor someone for their standing (the meaning decision). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means. Korean "사람" needs no gender span, where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: "할례[받은 사람들]", "무할례[인 사람들]" (L); "할례받은 사람들", "할례받지 않은 사람들" (B); "유대인", "유대인이 아닌 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul names the two peoples by circumcision (the meaning decision). Literal brackets the words Korean needs to make a people of them; Balanced says it plainly; Readable names them, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "사귐의 오른손" (L); "오른손을 내밀어 사귐의 악수를 나누었습니다" (B); "동역자로서 악수를 청했습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The right hand of fellowship is a handshake sealing a partnership (the meaning decision). "사귐" (fellowship) is plain current Korean; "교제" is also current, but in everyday Korean usually means dating. Readable says what the handshake meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Phi-e-rơ" where the Greek says Peter (verses 7-8); "Sê-pha" (L, B), "Phi-e-rơ" (R) where it says Cephas (verses 9, 11, 14)
decisions.reason: Paul uses both names in this chapter, and Literal and Balanced keep the one he wrote, as the English does; Readable gives "Phi-e-rơ" each time so that new readers see one man (m9).

decisions.choice: "sự thông công" (L, B); "những người cùng chung công việc" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thông công" is the church word for fellowship, a sharing in a common life and work; the right hand sealed a partnership (m10), which Readable says plainly.
