pt.L: Mas, se, procurando ser justificados {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, nós mesmos também fomos achados pecadores, então {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [é] servo do pecado?
pt.B: Mas, se, enquanto procuramos ser declarados justos {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, nós mesmos também somos considerados pecadores, isso faz {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} um servo do pecado?
pt.R: Nós estamos procurando ser aceitos por Deus como justos por estarmos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}. Imaginem que isso mostre que nós também somos pecadores, assim como os não judeus. Será que isso quer dizer que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} está trabalhando a favor do pecado?

am.L: ነገር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ልንጸድቅ ስንፈልግ እኛ ራሳችን ደግሞ ኃጢአተኞች ሆነን ከተገኘን፣ እንግዲያስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የኃጢአት አገልጋይ ነውን?
am.B: ነገር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ለመጽደቅ ስንሻ እኛ ራሳችንም ኃጢአተኞች ሆነን ብንገኝ፣ ይህ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} የኃጢአት አገልጋይ ያደርገዋልን?
am.R: {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አንድ በመሆን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት ለማግኘት እየፈለግን ነው። ይህ እኛም ልክ አይሁድ እንዳልሆኑት ሕዝቦች ኃጢአተኞች መሆናችንን ያሳያል እንበል። ታዲያ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ለኃጢአት ይሠራል ማለት ነውን?

hi.L: पर यदि मसीह में धर्मी ठहराए जाने का यत्न करते हुए हम आप भी पापी पाए गए, तो क्या मसीह पाप के सेवक हैं?
hi.B: पर यदि मसीह में धर्मी ठहराए जाने का यत्न करते हुए हम भी पापी पाए जाते हैं, तो क्या इससे मसीह पाप के सेवक बन जाते हैं?
hi.R: हम मसीह के साथ जुड़कर परमेश्वर की दृष्टि में सही ठहराए जाने का यत्न कर रहे हैं। मान लो, इससे यह दिखे कि हम भी ग़ैर-यहूदियों की तरह पापी हैं। तो क्या इसका अर्थ यह है कि मसीह पाप के लिए काम करते हैं?

ru.L: Если же, стремясь оправдаться {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, мы и сами оказались грешниками, то разве {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} — служитель греха?
ru.B: Но если, стремясь к оправданию {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, мы и сами оказываемся грешниками, разве это делает {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} служителем греха?
ru.R: Мы хотим, чтобы Бог оправдал нас, потому что мы соединены с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}. Допустим, оказывается, что и мы такие же грешники, как люди из других народов. Значит ли это, что {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} работает на грех?

ja.L: しかし、もし{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}にあって義とされることを求めながら、わたしたち自身もまた罪人であると見られたのなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は罪に仕える者なのでしょうか？
ja.B: しかし、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に結ばれて義とされようとしているわたしたち自身も、罪人であるということになるのなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は罪に仕える者なのでしょうか？
ja.R: わたしたちは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と一つにされることによって、神に正しい者と認めていただこうとしています。そのために、わたしたちも、ユダヤ人でない人々と同じように罪人だということになったとしましょう。それなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は罪のために働いておられるということでしょうか？

uk.L: А якщо, шукаючи виправдання {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, ми й самі виявилися грішниками, то чи {{christos:Христос|Месія}} — служитель гріха?
uk.B: Але якщо, прагнучи виправдання {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, ми й самі виявляємося грішниками, то хіба {{christos:Христос|Месія}} стає служителем гріха?
uk.R: Ми прагнемо, щоб Бог виправдав нас, бо ми зʼєднані з {{christos:Христом|Месією}}. Припустімо, що через це видно, що й ми грішники, так само як неюдеї. Хіба це означає, що {{christos:Христос|Месія}} працює на гріх?

decisions.choice: found to be sinners: put, by leaving the law aside, in the same place as the Gentile "sinners" of verse 15
alternatives: found to be committing sins after coming to Christ
decisions.reason: Verse 15 called Gentiles "sinners" because they lived outside the law. When Jewish believers seek to be justified in Christ and not by the law, and eat with Gentiles, those who keep the law count them sinners too. Paul grants the point, in a sense: Jews also are sinners who need justifying (verse 16).

decisions.choice: a question: is Christ then a servant of sin?
alternatives: a statement: then Christ is a servant of sin
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT accents the word as ἆρα, which asks a question, and prints a question mark. The next words, "may it never be!", answer it.

decisions.choice: servant of sin: one who works for sin and promotes it
decisions.reason: διάκονος is one who serves another and acts on their behalf. The charge Paul answers is that if faith in Christ leads Jews to drop the law and be counted sinners, Christ is encouraging sin.

decisions.choice: justified in Christ: by being joined to him
alternatives: by Christ as the means only
decisions.reason: ἐν Χριστῷ is Paul's way of speaking of union with Christ: believers are justified as those who belong to him (3:26-28).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: put right with God; by being joined to; just like the Gentiles; working for sin
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plain wording for "justified" set in verse 16, says what "in Christ" means (m4), links "sinners" back to verse 15 (m1), and explains "servant of sin" (m3).

decisions.choice: servidor
decisions.reason: As in Romans, "servidor" for the word for one who acts on another's behalf, keeping "siervo" and "esclavo" apart from it.

decisions.choice: mtumishi
decisions.reason: As in Romans, "mtumishi" (servant, one who acts for another) for the Greek word here; "mtumwa" is kept for a slave.

decisions.choice: "죄의 일꾼" (L); "죄를 섬기는 분" (B); "죄를 위해 일하신다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the one for a servant, not a slave (the meaning decision): one who works for sin. "일꾼" is the Korean word kept for this Greek word, as in Colossians 1:7; the honorific -시- stays on Christ even in the question.

decisions.choice: "người phục vụ tội lỗi" (L, B) for diakonos
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (1:23) and Romans (15:8), diakonos is "người phục vụ", kept apart from "đầy tớ" for doulos. Readable says "working for sin".

decisions.choice: የኃጢአት አገልጋይ (servant of sin)
decisions.reason: The Greek word here is not Paul's word for a slave but one who serves and promotes something (meaning decision m3), so it is "አገልጋይ", kept apart from "ባሪያ".

decisions.choice: "पाप के सेवक" (L, B); "पाप के लिए काम करते हैं" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is diakonos, which the style guide renders "सेवक", kept apart from "दास" for doulos. Readable says what a servant of sin does (meaning decision m3).

ja.L: 決してそうではありません！
ja.B: 決してそうではありません！
ja.R: もちろん、そんなことはありません！

decisions.choice: the strongest possible denial
decisions.reason: μὴ γένοιτο, "may it not happen", is Paul's strongest way of rejecting a false conclusion (3:21; Romans 3:4, 6:2).

decisions.choice: Certainly not! (B); Of course not! (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use ordinary English for an emphatic no. "God forbid" adds a word for God that the Greek does not have.

decisions.choice: ¡No sea así! (L); ¡De ningún modo! (B); ¡Claro que no! (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as in Romans, so the reader meets Paul's strongest denial in one form across his letters. No word for God is added, as the English decision explains.

decisions.choice: Isiwe hivyo! (L); Hasha! (B); Sivyo kabisa! (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as in Romans, so the reader meets Paul's strongest denial in one form across his letters.

decisions.choice: Qu’il n’en soit rien ! (L); Absolument pas ! (B); Pas du tout ! (R); the same in 3:21
decisions.reason: Paul's strongest denial (m1). "À Dieu ne plaise" adds a word for God that the Greek does not have; Literal keeps the wish form, the other levels an ordinary emphatic no.

decisions.choice: "Không hề như vậy!" (L); "Chẳng hề như vậy!" (B); "Không đời nào!" (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Paul's strongest denial (m1), in the forms the Vietnamese Romans keeps for it (3:4), so the reader hears the same refusal each time (also 3:21).

decisions.choice: Que não aconteça! (L); De forma alguma! (B); Claro que não! (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as in Romans: Paul's strongest no (m1), the same Portuguese at each level wherever it returns (3:21; 6:14). Literal keeps the form of a wish; "Deus me livre" would add God's name, which the Greek does not have.

decisions.choice: ከቶ አይሁን! (L); በፍጹም! (B); በጭራሽ! (R)
decisions.reason: Paul's strongest denial (meaning decision m1) is a wish, "may it not be", which Literal keeps; Balanced and Readable use the everyday exclamations of flat refusal. The same wording is used in Romans.

decisions.choice: "ऐसा कभी न हो!" (L); "कदापि नहीं!" (B); "बिलकुल नहीं!" (R)
decisions.reason: The fixed forms of Romans for this denial (style guide, section 7b). No word for God is added.

decisions.choice: «Да не будет!» (L); «Ни в коем случае!» (B); «Конечно, нет!» (R)
decisions.reason: The forms settled in Romans for mē genoito.

decisions.choice: "決してそうではありません！" (L, B); "もちろん、そんなことはありません！" (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as Romans 6:2 for the strongest denial (m1), in the letter's polite style.

decisions.choice: Нехай не буде! (L); Аж ніяк! (B); Звичайно, ні! (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's wording for mē genoito, as in Romans. Also in 3:21.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ ἃ κατέλυσα ταῦτα πάλιν οἰκοδομῶ, παραβάτην ἐμαυτὸν συνιστάνω.

records.literal_gloss: If for what I tore down these again I build, a transgressor myself I prove.

en.L: For if I build again those things that I tore down, I prove myself [to be] a transgressor.
en.B: For if I rebuild what I tore down, I show that I am a lawbreaker.
en.R: Suppose I go back to the law as the way to be right with God, after I had torn that down. Then I show that I am the one who breaks the law.

es.L: Porque si lo que derribé, eso mismo vuelvo a edificar, me muestro a mí mismo [como] transgresor.
es.B: Porque si vuelvo a edificar lo que derribé, demuestro que soy un transgresor.
es.R: Supongamos que vuelvo a la ley como el camino para estar bien con Dios, después de haberla derribado. Entonces demuestro que el que quebranta la ley soy yo.

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa yale niliyoyabomoa nayajenga tena, najionyesha mwenyewe [kuwa] mvunja sheria.
sw.B: Kwa maana nikijenga tena kile nilichokibomoa, ninaonyesha kwamba mimi ni mvunja sheria.
sw.R: Tuseme ninarudi kwenye sheria kama njia ya kuwa sawa mbele za Mungu, baada ya kuwa nimeibomoa. Basi ninaonyesha kwamba mimi ndiye ninayevunja sheria.

fr.L: Car si ce que j’ai démoli, je le rebâtis, je me montre moi-même transgresseur.
fr.B: Car si je reconstruis ce que j’ai démoli, je me montre moi-même coupable d’enfreindre la Loi.
fr.R: Supposons que je revienne à la Loi comme moyen d’être juste devant Dieu, alors que j’avais démoli ce chemin. Alors je montre que c’est moi qui désobéis à la Loi.

ko.L: 만일 내가 헐었던 것들을 다시 세운다면, 나는 나 자신을 범법자로 증명하는 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 헐어 버린 것을 다시 세운다면, 나는 내가 율법을 어기는 사람이라는 것을 스스로 보여 주는 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 율법을 지켜서 하나님께 의롭다고 인정받는 길을 헐어 버려 놓고, 다시 그 길로 돌아간다고 해 봅시다. 그러면 율법을 어기는 사람은 바로 나라는 것을 내가 보여 주는 셈입니다.

vi.L: Vì nếu tôi xây dựng lại những gì tôi đã phá đổ, thì tôi tự chứng tỏ mình là người phạm luật pháp.
vi.B: Vì nếu tôi xây lại những gì tôi đã phá đổ, thì tôi tỏ ra mình là người phạm luật pháp.
vi.R: Giả sử sau khi đã phá đổ luật pháp như con đường để được đúng đắn với Đức Chúa Trời, tôi lại quay về với nó. Khi đó tôi cho thấy chính tôi là người phạm luật pháp.

pt.L: Pois, se edifico de novo as coisas que derrubei, provo que eu mesmo sou transgressor.
pt.B: Pois, se reconstruo o que derrubei, mostro que sou um transgressor da Lei.
pt.R: Imaginem que eu volte à Lei como o caminho para ser aceito por Deus, depois de ter derrubado isso. Então mostro que eu é que desobedeço à Lei.

am.L: ያፈረስኳቸውን እነዚያን ነገሮች እንደ ገና ብሠራ፣ ራሴን [ሕግ] ተላላፊ አድርጌ አሳያለሁና።
am.B: ያፈረስኩትን መልሼ ብገነባ፣ ሕግ ተላላፊ መሆኔን አሳያለሁና።
am.R: ሕጉን አፍርሼ ከቆየሁ በኋላ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት የማገኝበት መንገድ አድርጌ እንደ ገና ወደ እርሱ ብመለስ እንበል። ያን ጊዜ ሕጉን የምጥሰው እኔው መሆኔን አሳያለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि जो कुछ मैंने ढा दिया, यदि उसी को फिर बनाता हूँ, तो अपने आप को उल्लंघन करनेवाला सिद्ध करता हूँ।
hi.B: यदि जो मैंने ढा दिया, उसे मैं फिर से बनाता हूँ, तो मैं दिखाता हूँ कि मैं व्यवस्था तोड़नेवाला हूँ।
hi.R: मान लो, परमेश्वर की दृष्टि में सही ठहरने के मार्ग के रूप में मैंने व्यवस्था को ढा दिया था, और अब फिर उसी की ओर लौट जाऊँ। तब मैं दिखाता हूँ कि व्यवस्था तोड़नेवाला मैं ही हूँ।

ru.L: Ведь если я снова строю то, что разрушил, то показываю себя преступником.
ru.B: Ведь если я снова строю то, что разрушил, я показываю, что сам нарушаю Закон.
ru.R: Допустим, я снова возвращаюсь к Закону как к пути к праведности перед Богом, хотя сам разрушил этот путь. Тогда я сам показываю, что это я нарушаю Закон.

ja.L: というのは、もしわたしが打ち壊したものを再び建てるなら、わたしは自分自身が違反者であることを示すことになるからです。
ja.B: もし、わたしが自分で壊したものを再び建て直すなら、わたしは自分が律法を破る者であることを示すことになります。
ja.R: わたしは、律法を守ることで神に正しい者と認められるという考えを打ち壊しました。それなのに、もう一度その考えに戻ったとしましょう。そうすれば、律法を破っているのは自分だと、自分で示すことになります。

uk.L: Бо якщо я знову будую те, що зруйнував, то показую себе переступником.
uk.B: Бо якщо я знову будую те, що зруйнував, то показую, що я порушник Закону.
uk.R: Припустімо, я повернуся до Закону як до способу бути праведним перед Богом, хоча вже зруйнував це. Тоді я покажу, що порушник Закону — я.

decisions.choice: what was torn down: the law as the way to be accepted by God, and the wall it set between Jews and Gentiles
decisions.reason: Building and tearing down are Paul's picture for the law's place. By eating with Gentiles, Peter had in effect torn down the food laws as a barrier (verse 12); by withdrawing, he was rebuilding it. Paul uses "I" to state the principle without naming Peter.

decisions.choice: a transgressor: one who breaks God's law
alternatives: one who disobeys a human rule
decisions.reason: παραβάτης is someone who steps over a set line. Rebuilding the law as the way to God either admits that tearing it down was wrong, or puts a person back under a law that exposes them as a lawbreaker (3:10). Either way, the sinner is not made by Christ (verse 17) but by going back to the law.

decisions.choice: go back to the law as the way to be right with God
alternatives: build again what I tore down
decisions.reason: Readable says what the building picture means (m1). It is one way of filling out the picture; the reader should know the Greek is only "what I tore down, I build again".

decisions.choice: mvunja sheria
decisions.reason: "Mkosaji" is anyone who does wrong; "mvunja sheria" (lawbreaker) keeps the picture of crossing a set line and the link with the law that the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: "người phạm luật pháp" for this word
decisions.reason: The word is one who steps over a line God's law has drawn (m2); "phạm luật pháp" is the form of the Vietnamese Romans for this word family (2:23). "Kẻ" would add contempt.

decisions.choice: "उल्लंघन करनेवाला" (L); "व्यवस्था तोड़नेवाला" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means one who breaks God's law (meaning decision m2); "अपराधी" would suggest a criminal before a court, and "अपराध" is kept for trespass.

decisions.choice: "違反者" (L); "律法を破る者" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Romans 4:15: Literal keeps the noun, Balanced and Readable say whose law is broken (m2). "罪人" is kept for the word in verses 15 and 17.

source.text: ἐγὼ γὰρ διὰ νόμου νόμῳ ἀπέθανον ἵνα θεῷ ζήσω· Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι·

records.literal_gloss: I for through law to law died so that to God I might live; with Christ I have been crucified;

en.L: For I through [the] law died to [the] law, so that I might live to God. I have been crucified with {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: For through the law I died to the law, so that I might live for God. I have been crucified with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: It was through the law that I died to the law. Now the law no longer has any claim on me, so that I can live for God. When {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} was nailed to the cross, I was nailed there with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque yo por medio de [la] ley morí a [la] ley, a fin de vivir para Dios. Con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} he sido crucificado.
es.B: Porque por medio de la ley yo morí a la ley, a fin de vivir para Dios. He sido crucificado con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: Fue por medio de la ley que morí a la ley. Ahora la ley ya no tiene ningún derecho sobre mí, y así puedo vivir para Dios. Cuando {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} fue clavado en la cruz, yo fui clavado allí con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi kwa njia ya sheria niliifia sheria, ili niishi kwa ajili ya Mungu. Pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} nimesulubiwa.
sw.B: Kwa maana kupitia sheria niliifia sheria, ili niishi kwa ajili ya Mungu. Nimesulubiwa pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Kupitia sheria yenyewe niliifia sheria. Sasa sheria haina tena mamlaka juu yangu, kwa hiyo naweza kuishi kwa ajili ya Mungu. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alipopigiliwa misumari msalabani, mimi nilipigiliwa huko pamoja naye.

fr.L: Car moi, par la Loi, je suis mort à la Loi, afin de vivre pour Dieu. J’ai été crucifié avec {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.B: Car par la Loi je suis mort à la Loi, afin de vivre pour Dieu. J’ai été crucifié avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: C’est par la Loi que je suis mort à la Loi. Maintenant, la Loi n’a plus aucun droit sur moi, et je peux vivre pour Dieu. Quand le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a été cloué sur la croix, j’y ai été cloué avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

ko.L: 나는 율법을 통하여 율법에 대하여 죽었습니다. 하나님께 대하여 살려는 것입니다. 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 십자가에 못 박혔습니다.
ko.B: 나는 율법을 통해 율법에 대해 죽었습니다. 하나님을 위해 살려는 것입니다. 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 십자가에 못 박혔습니다.
ko.R: 나를 율법에 대해 죽게 한 것은 바로 율법이었습니다. 이제 율법은 나에게 아무 권리도 주장할 수 없습니다. 그래서 나는 하나님을 위해 살 수 있습니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 십자가에 못 박히실 때, 나도 그분과 함께 거기에 못 박혔습니다.

vi.L: Vì qua luật pháp, tôi đã chết đối với luật pháp, để tôi sống cho Đức Chúa Trời. Tôi đã bị đóng đinh vào thập tự giá với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Vì qua luật pháp, tôi đã chết đối với luật pháp, để tôi sống cho Đức Chúa Trời. Tôi đã bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá cùng với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Chính qua luật pháp mà tôi đã chết đối với luật pháp. Bây giờ luật pháp không còn quyền gì trên tôi nữa, để tôi có thể sống cho Đức Chúa Trời. Khi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá, tôi cũng đã bị đóng đinh ở đó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Pois eu, por meio da Lei, morri para a Lei, a fim de viver para Deus. Fui crucificado com {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Pois, por meio da Lei, eu morri para a Lei, para viver para Deus. Fui crucificado com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Foi por meio da Lei que eu morri para a Lei. Agora a Lei não tem mais nenhum direito sobre mim, e assim posso viver para Deus. Quando {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} foi pregado na cruz, eu fui pregado lá com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: እኔ ለእግዚአብሔር እኖር ዘንድ በሕግ በኩል ለሕግ ሞቻለሁና። {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር ተሰቅያለሁ።
am.B: እኔ ለእግዚአብሔር እንድኖር በሕግ በኩል ለሕግ ሞቻለሁ። {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር ተሰቅያለሁ።
am.R: ለሕግ የሞትኩት በሕግ በኩል ነው። አሁን ሕጉ በእኔ ላይ ምንም መብት የለውም፤ ስለዚህ ለእግዚአብሔር መኖር እችላለሁ። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በመስቀል ላይ በተቸነከረ ጊዜ እኔም ከእርሱ ጋር በዚያ ተቸንክሬአለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं व्यवस्था के द्वारा व्यवस्था के लिए मर गया, ताकि परमेश्वर के लिए जीऊँ। मैं मसीह के साथ क्रूस पर चढ़ाया गया हूँ।
hi.B: क्योंकि व्यवस्था के द्वारा मैं व्यवस्था के लिए मर गया, ताकि परमेश्वर के लिए जीवित रहूँ। मैं मसीह के साथ क्रूस पर चढ़ाया गया हूँ।
hi.R: व्यवस्था के द्वारा ही मैं व्यवस्था के लिए मर गया। अब मुझ पर व्यवस्था का कोई अधिकार नहीं है, ताकि मैं परमेश्वर के लिए जी सकूँ। जब मसीह को क्रूस पर कीलों से ठोंका गया, तब मैं भी उनके साथ वहाँ ठोंका गया।

ru.L: Ведь я через Закон умер для Закона, чтобы жить для Бога. {{christos:Со Христом|С Мессией}} я распят.
ru.B: Ведь через Закон я умер для Закона, чтобы жить для Бога. Я распят вместе с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}.
ru.R: Именно через Закон я умер для Закона. Теперь Закон больше не имеет на меня прав, и я могу жить для Бога. Когда {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} прибили к кресту, меня прибили к кресту вместе с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.

ja.L: というのは、わたしは律法を通して律法に対して死にました。神に対して生きるためです。わたしは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に十字架につけられています。
ja.B: わたしは律法によって律法に対して死にました。神のために生きるためです。わたしは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に十字架につけられたのです。
ja.R: 律法を通して、わたしは律法に対して死にました。今では律法はもう、わたしに対して何の権利も持っていません。それは、わたしが神のために生きるためです。{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}が十字架につけられたとき、わたしもいっしょに十字架につけられたのです。

uk.L: Бо я через Закон умер для Закону, щоб жити для Бога. Я розіпʼятий із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}.
uk.B: Бо через Закон я помер для Закону, щоб жити для Бога. Я розіпʼятий із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}.
uk.R: Саме через Закон я помер для Закону. Тепер Закон уже не має на мене жодного права, і я можу жити для Бога. Коли {{christos:Христа|Месію}} прибили до хреста, мене прибили там разом із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.

decisions.choice: "I have been crucified with Christ" ends verse 19, as the Greek verse numbers have it
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT, as in printed Greek texts generally, Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι closes verse 19. Many Bibles number the words as the start of verse 20. The words and their meaning are the same either way.

decisions.choice: the law itself brought about his death to the law: its curse fell on Christ, with whom he died
alternatives: the law showed him his sin and so drove him to Christ
decisions.reason: Paul does not explain "through the law". The next words, "crucified with Christ", and 3:13, where Christ became a curse under the law for us, suggest that the law's sentence was carried out in Christ's death, and the believer died with him. Others take it that the law, by condemning him, led him to give it up as a way to God (3:24). Both readings agree that the law itself led to this break.

decisions.choice: died to the law: the law no longer has authority over him, so that he lives for God
alternatives: he stopped caring about the law's moral teaching
decisions.reason: To die to something is to be set free from its rule (Romans 6:2, 10-11; 7:4-6). Paul does not leave the law in order to live for himself: the purpose is "that I might live for God".

decisions.choice: crucified with Christ: joined to Christ in his death, with lasting effect
decisions.reason: συνεσταύρωμαι is a perfect tense: it happened, and its effect continues. Paul shares in Christ's death because he is joined to him, as in Romans 6:6. Verse 20 draws out what follows: Christ now lives in him.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R); {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} (R)
decisions.reason: Title setting and pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: live for God
decisions.reason: "Live to God" is not natural English; "for God" gives the sense of living toward him and for his sake.

decisions.choice: the law no longer has any claim on me; nailed to the cross
decisions.reason: Readable says what dying to the law means (m3) and uses plain words for crucifixion.

decisions.choice: niliifia sheria
decisions.reason: The applied form "kufia" (to die to, die for) carries the Greek dative, so "niliifia sheria" says "I died to the law" in one verb; "nilikufa kwa sheria" could mean "I died by the law".

decisions.choice: pamoja naye, no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Swahili joins the pronoun to "na" ("naye"), the natural form, and a joined pronoun takes no capital, so the English pronoun setting on "him" has no Swahili span here.

decisions.choice: "chết đối với luật pháp" at every level
decisions.reason: The words say that the law's authority over him ended (m3); "chết đối với" is the form the Vietnamese Romans uses for dying to sin (6:2). "Chết cho" would sound like dying for the sake of the law.

decisions.choice: "十字架につけられています" (L); "十字架につけられたのです" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect is a past act with lasting effect (m4). Literal keeps the state with 〜ている; Balanced and Readable tell the event, as the English does.

source.text: ζῶ δὲ οὐκέτι ἐγώ, ζῇ δὲ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός· ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί, ἐν πίστει ζῶ τῇ τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντός με καὶ παραδόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I live and no longer I, lives and in me Christ; what and now I live in flesh, in faith I live the of the Son of the God the [one] having loved me and having handed over himself for me.

en.L: And no longer do I live, but {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} lives in me; and what I now live in [the] flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, the one who loved me and handed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} over for me.
en.B: I am no longer the one who lives; {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} lives in me. Whatever life I still have in the flesh is a life lived by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and handed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} over for my sake.
en.R: I am no longer the one living my life. Now {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} lives in me. I still live in this human body, but I live it by faith in the Son of God. He loved me and gave up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} life for me.

es.L: Y vivo, ya no yo, sino que vive en mí {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}; y lo que ahora vivo en [la] carne, en fe lo vivo, la [fe] en el Hijo de Dios, el que me amó y se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por mí.
es.B: Ya no soy yo quien vive; es {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} quien vive en mí. Lo que aún me queda de vida en la carne, lo vivo por la fe en el Hijo de Dios, que me amó y se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por mi bien.
es.R: Ya no soy yo quien vive mi vida. Ahora {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} vive en mí. Todavía vivo en este cuerpo humano, pero vivo por la fe en el Hijo de Dios. Él me amó y dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vida por mí.

sw.L: Na ninaishi, si mimi tena, bali {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anaishi ndani yangu; na maisha ninayoishi sasa katika mwili, ninayaishi kwa imani katika Mwana wa Mungu, yule aliyenipenda na kujitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa ajili yangu.
sw.B: Si mimi tena ninayeishi; {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ndiye anayeishi ndani yangu. Maisha yoyote ninayoishi bado katika mwili, ni maisha ya imani katika Mwana wa Mungu, aliyenipenda na kujitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa ajili yangu.
sw.R: Si mimi tena ninayeendesha maisha yangu. Sasa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anaishi ndani yangu. Bado ninaishi katika mwili huu wa kibinadamu, lakini ninaishi kwa imani katika Mwana wa Mungu. Yeye alinipenda, akayatoa maisha {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa ajili yangu.

fr.L: Et je vis, non plus moi, mais {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vit en moi ; et ce que je vis maintenant dans la chair, je le vis dans la foi au Fils de Dieu, qui m’a aimé et s’est livré {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour moi.
fr.B: Ce n’est plus moi qui vis : c’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} qui vit en moi. La vie que je vis encore dans la chair, je la vis dans la foi au Fils de Dieu, qui m’a aimé et qui s’est livré {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour moi.
fr.R: Ce n’est plus moi qui dirige ma vie. Maintenant, c’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} qui vit en moi. Je vis encore dans ce corps humain, mais je vis en mettant ma foi dans le Fils de Dieu. Il m’a aimé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} vie pour moi.

ko.L: 이제는 더 이상 내가 사는 것이 아니라 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 내 안에 사십니다. 내가 지금 육신 안에서 사는 것은, 나를 사랑하시고 나를 위하여 자기 자신을 내주신 하나님의 아들을 믿는 믿음 안에서 사는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이제 사는 사람은 내가 아닙니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 내 안에 사십니다. 내가 아직 육신으로 살아가는 삶은, 나를 사랑하시고 나를 위해 자신을 내주신 하나님의 아들을 믿는 믿음으로 사는 삶입니다.
ko.R: 이제 내 삶을 사는 사람은 내가 아닙니다. 이제는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 내 안에 사십니다. 나는 아직 이 사람의 몸으로 살고 있지만, 하나님의 아들을 믿는 믿음으로 이 삶을 삽니다. 그분은 나를 사랑하셔서 나를 위해 자기 목숨을 내주셨습니다.

vi.L: Và không còn tôi sống nữa, mà {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sống trong tôi; và sự sống mà bây giờ tôi sống trong xác thịt, tôi sống trong đức tin nơi Con của Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã yêu tôi và đã phó chính mình vì tôi.
vi.B: Người đang sống không còn là tôi nữa; chính {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sống trong tôi. Đời sống mà tôi còn sống trong xác thịt là đời sống bởi đức tin nơi Con của Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã yêu tôi và đã phó chính mình vì tôi.
vi.R: Không phải tôi đang tự sống đời mình nữa. Bây giờ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sống trong tôi. Tôi vẫn còn sống trong thân thể con người này, nhưng tôi sống bằng đức tin nơi Con của Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài đã yêu tôi và đã hy sinh mạng sống mình vì tôi.

pt.L: E já não vivo eu, mas {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} vive em mim; e o que agora vivo na carne, vivo pela fé no Filho de Deus, que me amou e entregou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} por mim.
pt.B: Já não sou eu quem vive; é {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que vive em mim. A vida que ainda vivo na carne, eu a vivo pela fé no Filho de Deus, que me amou e entregou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} por mim.
pt.R: Já não sou eu que vivo a minha vida. Agora é {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que vive em mim. Ainda vivo neste corpo humano, mas vivo pela fé no Filho de Deus. Ele me amou e deu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vida por mim.

am.L: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እኔ አልኖርም፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ግን በእኔ ይኖራል፤ አሁንም በሥጋ የምኖረውን [ኑሮ]፣ በወደደኝና ስለ እኔ ራሱን አሳልፎ በሰጠው በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ [ባለ] እምነት እኖራለሁ።
am.B: ከእንግዲህ የምኖረው እኔ አይደለሁም፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእኔ ይኖራል። አሁን በሥጋ የምኖረው ሕይወት ሁሉ፣ በወደደኝና ስለ እኔ ራሱን አሳልፎ በሰጠው በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ በማመን የምኖረው ሕይወት ነው።
am.R: ከእንግዲህ ሕይወቴን የምኖረው እኔ አይደለሁም። አሁን {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእኔ ይኖራል። አሁንም በዚህ ሰብአዊ አካል እኖራለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የምኖረው በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ በማመን ነው። እርሱ ወደደኝ፤ ሕይወቱንም ስለ እኔ ሰጠ።

hi.L: और अब मैं जीवित नहीं रहा, पर मसीह मुझमें जीवित हैं; और अब मैं जो शरीर में जीता हूँ, वह परमेश्वर के पुत्र पर विश्वास से जीता हूँ, जिन्होंने मुझसे प्रेम किया और मेरे लिए अपने आप को सौंप दिया।
hi.B: अब जीनेवाला मैं नहीं रहा; मसीह मुझमें जीते हैं। शरीर में जो जीवन मैं अब जीता हूँ, वह परमेश्वर के पुत्र पर विश्वास से जीता हूँ, जिन्होंने मुझसे प्रेम किया और मेरे लिए अपने आप को सौंप दिया।
hi.R: अब मैं अपना जीवन चलानेवाला नहीं रहा। अब मसीह मुझमें जीते हैं। मैं अब भी इस मानवीय शरीर में जीता हूँ, पर मैं यह जीवन परमेश्वर के पुत्र पर विश्वास करते हुए जीता हूँ। उन्होंने मुझसे प्रेम किया और मेरे लिए अपनी जान दे दी।

ru.L: И живу уже не я, но во мне живёт {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}; а ту жизнь, которой я теперь живу во плоти, я живу верой в Сына Божьего, который полюбил меня и предал себя за меня.
ru.B: Живу больше не я — во мне живёт {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}. А та жизнь, что у меня ещё есть во плоти, — это жизнь верой в Сына Божьего, который полюбил меня и предал себя ради меня.
ru.R: Свою жизнь живу уже не я. Теперь во мне живёт {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}. Я ещё живу в этом человеческом теле, но живу верой в Сына Божьего. Он полюбил меня и отдал за меня свою жизнь.

ja.L: わたしは生きています。しかし、もはやわたしではなく、わたしのうちで{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}が生きておられるのです。そして、今わたしが肉にあって生きている[命]は、わたしを愛し、わたしのためにご自分を引き渡された神の子への信仰において生きているのです。
ja.B: もうわたし自身が生きているのではなく、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がわたしのうちで生きておられるのです。今わたしが肉体をもって生きているこの命は、わたしを愛し、わたしのためにご自分を引き渡してくださった神の子への信仰による命です。
ja.R: わたしの命を生きているのは、もうわたしではありません。今は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がわたしのうちで生きておられます。わたしは今もこの体で生きていますが、神の子を信じる信仰によって生きているのです。神の子はわたしを愛し、わたしのためにご自分の命を差し出してくださいました。

uk.L: І вже не я живу, а живе в мені {{christos:Христос|Месія}}; а що тепер живу в тілі, то живу вірою в Сина Божого, який полюбив мене і віддав себе за мене.
uk.B: Я вже не той, хто живе; у мені живе {{christos:Христос|Месія}}. А життя, яке я ще маю в тілі, — це життя вірою в Сина Божого, який полюбив мене і віддав себе за мене.
uk.R: Я вже не той, хто живе своїм життям. Тепер у мені живе {{christos:Христос|Месія}}. Я ще живу в цьому людському тілі, але живу вірою в Сина Божого. Він полюбив мене і віддав за мене своє життя.

decisions.choice: the old "I" died with Christ; the life Paul now lives comes from Christ living in him
decisions.reason: The "I" who lived under the law died with Christ (verse 19). Paul still lives, as the next clause says, but Christ is the source and Lord of that life. Elsewhere Paul speaks of Christ in believers by the Spirit (Romans 8:9-10).

decisions.choice: flesh: ordinary bodily, mortal human life
decisions.reason: Here σάρξ means human life in the body, as in Philippians 1:22. It is not the sinful self opposed to the Spirit that Paul speaks of in 5:13-24.

decisions.choice: by faith in the Son of God
alternatives: by the faithfulness of the Son of God
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, πίστις with a genitive can be faith directed to someone or that person's own faithfulness. The second reading points to the words that follow, "who loved me and handed himself over", as a description of the Son's own faithful act. The first fits verse 16, where "we have believed in Christ Jesus" stands between the two such phrases. We follow "faith in" and give "faithfulness of" in a footnote; both readings agree that Paul's life rests on the Son's love and death.

decisions.choice: handed himself over: gave himself up to death, for Paul's sake
decisions.reason: παραδίδωμι is the verb used of Jesus being handed over to death (Romans 4:25; 8:32). Here he hands himself over, as in 1:4, freely and out of love. "For me" makes the love personal: what Christ did for all he did for Paul.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R); {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}
decisions.reason: Title setting and pronoun setting. "Son" is God's Son and takes no setting.

decisions.choice: handed himself over
decisions.reason: "Handed over" keeps the link with the verb used of Jesus being handed over to death (m4). Readable says it plainly: he gave up his life.

decisions.choice: in this human body
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "flesh" here (m2), so that it is not read as the sinful self.

decisions.choice: I am no longer the one who lives (B); I am no longer the one living my life (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek stresses "I" at the end of the clause; Balanced and Readable bring out that emphasis: Paul lives, but not as the one in charge of his life.

decisions.choice: se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}
decisions.reason: The reflexive "se" is joined to the verb and takes no capital; the setting goes on the free "sí mismo".

decisions.choice: katika mwili (L, B); katika mwili huu wa kibinadamu (R)
decisions.reason: Here "flesh" is ordinary bodily life (meaning decision), so Swahili keeps "mwili" at Literal and Balanced, where it reads naturally as the body, and Readable says "mwili huu wa kibinadamu". "Asili ya dhambi" is kept for chapter 5, where the flesh is the sinful self.

decisions.choice: s'est livré {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Livrer" keeps the link with the verb used of Jesus being handed over to death (m4); 1:4 uses a different verb, "donner".

decisions.choice: "육신 안에서" (L); "육신으로" (B); "이 사람의 몸으로" (R)
decisions.reason: "육신" is the letter's word for the flesh at Literal, as in Romans. Here it means ordinary mortal human life, not the sinful nature (the meaning decision), so Readable says "이 사람의 몸", as the English Readable says "this human body". |

decisions.choice: "하나님의 아들을 믿는 믿음" at every level
decisions.reason: As at 2:16: the meaning decision reads it as faith in the Son of God, and Korean "...의 믿음" would be read as the Son's own faith.

decisions.choice: "trong xác thịt" (L, B); "trong thân thể con người này" (R)
decisions.reason: Here flesh is ordinary bodily, mortal life (m2), not human nature turned from God. Literal and Balanced keep "xác thịt", the word kept for sarx, which the context makes clear; Readable says "this human body", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: na carne (L, B); neste corpo humano (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as in Romans and docs/portuguese-style.md section 6: Literal and Balanced keep "a carne"; Readable follows the meaning decision each time, here ordinary bodily life (m2), and in chapter 5 the sinful self ("a natureza pecadora").

decisions.choice: ሥጋ (flesh, L, B), here and through the letter; Readable says what it means in each place (here ሰብአዊ አካል, this human body)
decisions.reason: "ሥጋ" is kept for Paul's word flesh at Literal and Balanced through the letter, as in Romans, so a reader can follow it from here to 3:3 and chapters 5 and 6, where flesh is set against the Spirit. Here it means ordinary bodily, mortal life (meaning decision m2), and Readable says so.

decisions.choice: በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ [ባለ] እምነት (L); በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ በማመን (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m3) reads the phrase as faith in the Son of God. "የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እምነት" would read as the Son's own faith, so Literal makes the object plain with "በ..." and a bracketed "ባለ", and Balanced uses the verb, as in Romans 3:22 and Galatians 2:16.

decisions.choice: "शरीर में" (L, B); "इस मानवीय शरीर में" (R)
decisions.reason: Here flesh means ordinary bodily human life (meaning decision m2), not the sinful self, so Readable keeps "शरीर" and does not use "शारीरिक स्वभाव".

decisions.choice: "अपने आप को सौंप दिया" (L, B); "अपनी जान दे दी" (R)
decisions.reason: "सौंप देना" is the verb the Gospels use for Jesus being handed over to death (meaning decision m4); Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: себя, свою, without a setting
decisions.reason: The English has the pronoun setting on "himself" and "his"; the Russian reflexives "себя" and "свой" take none.

decisions.choice: во плоти (L, B); в этом человеческом теле (R)
decisions.reason: Here flesh is ordinary bodily life (m2), so Readable says "тело", as the style guide asks where flesh is the body.

decisions.choice: "肉にあって" (L); "肉体をもって" (B); "この体で" (R)
decisions.reason: Here flesh is ordinary bodily, mortal life (m2), not Paul's moral sense, so Balanced and Readable say body, and the Readable gloss for the moral sense is not used.

decisions.choice: "わたしは生きています。しかし、もはやわたしではなく" (L); "もうわたし自身が生きているのではなく" (B)
alternatives: "生きているのは、もはやわたしではない"
decisions.reason: Literal follows the Greek "I live, no longer I". The phrasing of the best-known Japanese versions is avoided on purpose: the sense is the same, the wording is fresh.

source.text: οὐκ ἀθετῶ τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰ γὰρ διὰ νόμου δικαιοσύνη, ἄρα Χριστὸς δωρεὰν ἀπέθανεν.

records.literal_gloss: Not I set aside the grace of the God; if for through law righteousness, then Christ for nothing died.

en.L: I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness [comes] through [the] law, then {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} died for nothing.
en.B: I do not cancel out God's grace. For if righteousness comes through the law, then {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} died for nothing at all.
en.R: I do not push God's grace aside. If people could become righteous, right with God, by keeping the law, then {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} died for no reason.

es.L: No dejo a un lado la gracia de Dios; porque si la justicia [viene] por medio de [la] ley, entonces {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} murió en vano.
es.B: No anulo la gracia de Dios. Porque si la justicia viene por medio de la ley, entonces {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} murió para nada.
es.R: Yo no hago a un lado la gracia de Dios. Si las personas pudieran llegar a ser justas, estar bien con Dios, por cumplir la ley, entonces {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} murió sin ninguna razón.

sw.L: Siiweki kando neema ya Mungu; kwa maana kama haki [huja] kupitia sheria, basi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa bure.
sw.B: Siifanyi neema ya Mungu kuwa batili. Kwa maana ikiwa haki inakuja kupitia sheria, basi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa bure kabisa.
sw.R: Mimi siisukumi kando neema ya Mungu. Kama watu wangeweza kuwa wenye haki, yaani kuwa sawa mbele za Mungu, kwa kushika sheria, basi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa bila sababu yoyote.

fr.L: Je ne rejette pas la grâce de Dieu ; car si la justice [vient] par la Loi, alors {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est mort pour rien.
fr.B: Je ne rends pas vaine la grâce de Dieu. Car si la justice s’obtient par la Loi, alors le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour rien.
fr.R: Je ne mets pas de côté la grâce de Dieu. Si les gens pouvaient devenir justes devant Dieu en obéissant à la Loi, alors la mort du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’aurait servi à rien.

ko.L: 나는 하나님의 은혜를 무효로 만들지 않습니다. 만일 의가 율법을 통해서 [온다면], {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 헛되이 죽으신 것입니다.
ko.B: 나는 하나님의 은혜를 헛되게 하지 않습니다. 의가 율법을 통해 온다면, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 아무 이유 없이 죽으신 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 나는 하나님의 은혜를 밀어내지 않습니다. 율법을 지켜서 사람이 의롭게, 곧 하나님과 바른 관계가 될 수 있다면, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 괜히 죽으신 것입니다.

vi.L: Tôi không gạt bỏ ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời; vì nếu sự công chính [đến] qua luật pháp, thì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết vô ích.
vi.B: Tôi không vô hiệu hóa ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời. Vì nếu sự công chính đến qua luật pháp, thì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết hoàn toàn vô ích.
vi.R: Tôi không gạt ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời sang một bên. Nếu người ta có thể trở nên công chính, tức là đúng đắn với Đức Chúa Trời, bằng cách giữ luật pháp, thì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết chẳng vì lý do gì.

pt.L: Não anulo a graça de Deus; pois, se a justiça [vem] por meio da Lei, então {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} morreu em vão.
pt.B: Não invalido a graça de Deus. Pois, se a justiça vem por meio da Lei, então {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} morreu por nada.
pt.R: Eu não deixo de lado a graça de Deus. Se as pessoas pudessem ser justas, aceitas por Deus, por cumprirem a Lei, então {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} morreu sem motivo.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ አልሽርም፤ ጽድቅ በሕግ በኩል [የሚገኝ] ከሆነማ፣ እንግዲያስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በከንቱ ሞተ።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ከንቱ አላደርግም። ጽድቅ በሕግ በኩል የሚገኝ ከሆነ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የሞተው ፈጽሞ በከንቱ ነው።
am.R: የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ወደ ጎን አልገፋም። ሰዎች ሕጉን በመጠበቅ ጻድቃን፣ ማለትም ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት ያላቸው፣ መሆን ከቻሉ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የሞተው ያለ ምክንያት ነው።

hi.L: मैं परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह को व्यर्थ नहीं ठहराता; क्योंकि यदि धार्मिकता व्यवस्था के द्वारा [मिलती], तो मसीह व्यर्थ ही मरे।
hi.B: मैं परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह को रद्द नहीं करता। क्योंकि यदि धार्मिकता व्यवस्था के द्वारा मिलती, तो मसीह व्यर्थ ही मरे।
hi.R: मैं परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह को एक ओर नहीं हटाता। यदि लोग व्यवस्था का पालन करके धर्मी बन सकते, यानी परमेश्वर के साथ सही संबंध में आ सकते, तो मसीह बेकार ही मरे।

ru.L: Не отвергаю благодати Божьей; ведь если через Закон — праведность, то {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер напрасно.
ru.B: Я не отменяю Божью благодать. Ведь если праведность приходит через Закон, то {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер совершенно напрасно.
ru.R: Я не отталкиваю Божью благодать. Если бы люди могли стать праведными, правыми перед Богом, исполняя Закон, то {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер бы зря.

ja.L: わたしは神の恵みを無にしません。というのは、もし義が律法を通して[来る]のなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は無駄に死なれたことになるからです。
ja.B: わたしは神の恵みを無効にはしません。もし義が律法によって得られるのなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は何の意味もなく死なれたことになります。
ja.R: わたしは、神の恵みをわきへ押しやったりはしません。もし人が律法を守ることによって義とされる、つまり神の前に正しい者となれるのなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}が死なれたのは、何の理由もなかったことになってしまいます。

uk.L: Я не відкидаю благодаті Божої; бо якщо праведність через Закон, то {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер даремно.
uk.B: Я не скасовую Божої благодаті. Бо якщо праведність приходить через Закон, то {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер зовсім даремно.
uk.R: Я не відкидаю Божої благодаті. Якби люди могли стати праведними, тобто правими перед Богом, виконуючи Закон, то {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер би без жодної причини.

decisions.choice: set aside: treat as of no account, make void
decisions.reason: ἀθετέω is used of setting aside or annulling an agreement, as in 3:15. To make the law the way to righteousness would treat God's grace, shown in Christ's death, as if it counted for nothing. Paul may be answering a charge that he set aside the law; he turns it round.

decisions.choice: righteousness: a right standing before God
decisions.reason: δικαιοσύνη here goes with being justified (verses 16-17): the standing of one God declares to be in the right. Philippians 3:9 contrasts the same two sources of it, the law and faith in Christ.

decisions.choice: for nothing: without cause or purpose
decisions.reason: δωρεὰν can mean "as a gift" or "for no reason, in vain". Here only the second fits: if the law could give righteousness, Christ's death would have achieved nothing that was needed.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: people could become righteous, right with God, by keeping the law
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "righteous" and adds what it means here (m2), and says how the law would give it: by keeping it.

decisions.choice: la justice (L, B); devenir justes devant Dieu (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Justice" is the usual French Bible word for this right standing before God (m2), as in Hebrews 5:13, though everyday French links it with the courts. Readable says what it means, keeping the word "juste" so that the link with "déclarer juste" in 2:16 is not lost.

decisions.choice: "의" at every level, Readable adding "하나님과 바른 관계" (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in Romans: "의" is the key term the Korean style guide gives for righteousness, and the root of "의롭다고 인정하다" (2:16). Here it is a right standing before God (the meaning decision), which Readable says alongside the word, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "sự công chính" (L, B); "công chính, tức là đúng đắn với Đức Chúa Trời" (R) for righteousness (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The key term of the style guide and the Vietnamese Romans (1:17), one family with "xưng công chính". Here it is a right standing before God (m2), which Readable says, keeping the key word as well.

decisions.choice: "ân điển" for grace at every level (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The key term of the style guide, as in the Vietnamese John, Colossians and Romans; "ân sủng" is the Catholic word.

decisions.choice: a justiça (L, B); ser justas, aceitas por Deus (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as in Romans: "justiça" and "justo" carry the right standing before God (m2) and keep the link with "justificar"; "retidão" names only moral uprightness.

decisions.choice: "धार्मिकता" (L, B); "धर्मी बन सकते, यानी परमेश्वर के साथ सही संबंध में आ सकते" (R)
decisions.reason: The key term of Romans. Readable keeps the word and adds what it means here, a right standing before God (meaning decision m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: праведность (L, B); стать праведными (R)
decisions.reason: Key term, as in Romans: right standing before God (m2). Readable keeps the word and says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "義とされる、つまり神の前に正しい者となれる" (R); "義" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is a right standing before God (m2). As the English Readable, Readable names the church word once and explains it.
